This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
  • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
  • This posting is for a new position
  • Reporting to the Senior Director, EPD Operations

As a Staff Technical Program Manager, Emerging Products, you’ll…

  • Own the execution portfolio for an emerging product line from discovery through GA, across multiple engineering pods and cross-functional workstreams spanning Engineering, Product, Design, and GTM.
  • Partner with Engineering leaders, Tech Leads, and PMs to decompose ambiguous, high-risk technical challenges into clear milestones, sequencing, and execution plans that drive toward abstract goals.
  • Design and run the operating model for a fast-moving, zero-to-one program: pod structure, DRI cadences, cross-functional leads syncs, readiness checklists, and leadership reviews that read from artifacts teams already produce rather than creating new reporting.
  • Define GA and launch readiness criteria with Product, Engineering, and GTM, and drive the trade-off decisions needed to hit them, with a named owner and decision date for each.
  • Anticipate risks and dependencies across pillars, establish proactive risk management, and give executives data-driven visibility into where the program actually stands.
  • Build repeatable systems, health metrics, and playbooks that outlive this program and become the default for how Webflow takes new products to market, embedding AI tooling and automation to scale visibility and reduce manual coordination.
  • Coach EMs, PMs, and peer TPMs on execution craft and ownership behaviors, raising the quality of program management around you.

About you:

Requirements:

  • BS / BA college degree or relevant experience
  • 7+ years of experience in technical program management, with a proven track record of running strategic, cross-pillar programs

You’ll thrive as a Staff Technical Program Manager, Emerging Products if you:

  • Have taken a new product from zero to launch, or led programs in an incubation, new-venture, or emerging-technology environment where scope, staffing, and requirements were still being defined.
  • Have a strong technical foundation and are comfortable partnering with technical leaders on architecture trade-offs and execution structure. Experience with AI, agentic, or developer platform products is strongly preferred.
  • Have built repeatable systems (operating cadences, readiness frameworks, health metrics) that improved execution beyond a single program and were adopted by others.
  • Are hyper-organized and capable of coordinating across multiple independent work streams and organizations without losing the thread.
  • Thrive in ambiguity: you frame trade-offs, facilitate prioritization, and bring forward recommended solutions rather than open questions.
  • Are a role model for effective execution practices, driven by an attuned sense of priority and urgency, and able to say the hard thing with care.
  • Communicate effectively with executives and engineers alike, and are a confident presenter to leadership teams and large internal groups.
  • Are proficient with program management tooling (e.g., Linear, Jira, Confluence, Google Suite) and able to introduce lightweight processes that scale.
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
  • Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
  • Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
  • Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
  • Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
  • Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
  • Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
  • Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

raw.description:
About Zapata Quantum

Zapata Quantum is shaping the future of quantum computing: setting the standards for what’s viable, valuable, and worth building. The Company powers quantum applications across cryptography, pharmaceuticals, finance, materials discovery, defense, and beyond, translating cutting-edge research into real-world impact.

Zapata is the only organization to have contributed across every technical area of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking program, giving it a uniquely comprehensive view of what it takes to make quantum computing work in practice. Now restructured and sharply focused, Zapata Quantum stands alone as the only publicly traded, pure-play quantum software company fully dedicated to unlocking quantum’s commercial potential.

We’re rebuilding at a pivotal moment for the industry—bringing together a team that will help define how quantum delivers value in the real world, with the opportunity for meaningful ownership as we shape the commercial path forward.

About the role

We are seeking a Quantum Software Engineer to build AI-powered tools that massively accelerate how quantum applications are designed and resource-estimated. You will fuse modern AI—LLMs, coding agents, and ML-based heuristics—with quantum circuit construction, compilation, and analysis, compressing workflows that currently take weeks of expert effort into hours. Your tooling will directly shape Zapata’s ability to evaluate and deliver quantum solutions across cryptography, pharmaceuticals, finance, materials discovery, and defense.

This position offers a high level of individual ownership and is well-suited to engineers who are excited to push the frontier of AI-assisted scientific software within a small, focused team. You will partner closely with algorithm scientists and customers to understand their design and resource-estimation workflows, then build tools that turn those workflows into automated, scalable pipelines. This position is classified as exempt under applicable wage and hour laws.

What you'll do

  • Design and build AI-powered tools that accelerate quantum application design—from problem intake through algorithm selection, circuit construction, and validation
  • Develop automated resource estimation pipelines that use LLMs and ML models to rapidly predict qubit counts, gate counts, and runtime for candidate quantum solutions
  • Build agentic workflows that orchestrate quantum SDKs, compilation passes, simulators, and analysis tools
  • Integrate state-of-the-art AI coding assistants and LLM APIs directly into internal scientific tooling to compress expert-led workflows into automated pipelines
  • Benchmark and continuously improve the accuracy, speed, and reliability of AI-driven tooling against expert-curated baselines
  • Collaborate closely with quantum algorithm scientists to capture their reasoning and encode it into reusable AI-driven tools
  • Deliver high-quality software with minimal supervision, demonstrating autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code review, and CI/CD practices
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Demonstrated experience shipping software that leverages LLMs, AI agents, or other machine learning components
  • Proficient programming skills in Python, with working knowledge of modern LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or equivalent) and tool-use / function-calling patterns
  • Deep familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) and a drive to use them to massively accelerate your own output and that of the team
  • Familiarity with quantum computing concepts and a willingness to learn quantum algorithms and resource estimation in depth
  • Ability to work independently and manage deliverables with minimal oversight
  • Strong judgment about when to apply AI and when not to
  • A commitment to measuring tool quality against expert baselines

Desired Programming Skills

  • Python — for tooling, scientific code, and LLM-powered applications
  • LLM APIs and tool-use / function-calling patterns (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar)
  • Agent frameworks and orchestration (LangGraph, pydantic-ai, or custom harnesses)
  • Quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, or similar) for scripting design and estimation workflows
  • AI-assisted development (e.g., Claude Code)
  • Git and modern CI/CD tooling
  • Evals and benchmark design for AI systems
  • Software testing frameworks (pytest, hypothesis)
  • NumPy, SciPy, and the scientific Python stack
  • Retrieval-augmented generation and vector databases
  • Containerization (Docker) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Prompt Engineering

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated experience shipping software that leverages LLMs, AI agents, or other machine learning components
  • Experience building developer tools, scientific workflows, or research automation that leverages AI to speed up expert work
  • Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating across research and engineering teams

raw.description:
A Elevus encontra-se a recrutar para uma posição de Systems Administrator – IT Governance & Controls, para integração numa equipa de IT Infrastructure.

A função combina uma componente de suporte e conhecimento técnico de infraestrutura com responsabilidades de governance, controlos de IT, auditoria, gestão de acessos e melhoria de processos. O regime de trabalho é 100% remoto.

Função

Será responsável pela implementação, acompanhamento e melhoria dos controlos operacionais de IT, assegurando também o suporte a processos de auditoria, certificação de acessos e remediação de riscos.

A posição terá contacto transversal com diferentes áreas de IT, equipas de Information Security, auditores e outros stakeholders internos e externos.

Responsabilidades

  • Implementar e gerir controlos de governance associados à infraestrutura de IT;
  • Acompanhar diariamente a execução e monitorização dos controlos;
  • Gerir riscos e controlos a um nível técnico;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos e operações de IT;
  • Implementar políticas e procedimentos internos de IT;
  • Contribuir para a definição, desenvolvimento e atualização de políticas;
  • Produzir documentação técnica de alto e baixo nível alinhada com frameworks de controlo;
  • Trabalhar com equipas técnicas na implementação de políticas nos diferentes sistemas;
  • Coordenar a preparação e resposta a auditorias de IT;
  • Acompanhar planos de remediação em articulação com equipas de IT e Information Security;
  • Rever contratos de negócio e fornecedores de IT na perspetiva de conformidade e controlo;
  • Gerir processos mensais e trimestrais de revisão e certificação de acessos;
  • Recolher, tratar e analisar dados necessários aos processos de controlo;
  • Apoiar processos de Joiner, Mover & Leaver (JML) relacionados com recertificação e auditoria;
  • Criar e manter documentação de infraestrutura, implementação e gestão de alterações;
  • Apoiar a restante equipa de infraestrutura sempre que necessário.

Perfil

MUST HAVE

  • Experiência em suporte de infraestrutura de 2.º ou 3.º nível;
  • Experiência em IT Governance;
  • Experiência com processos de auditoria e controlos de IT;
  • Conhecimento de frameworks como SOX, NIST, ISO ou CIS;
  • Experiência prática com diferentes tecnologias de infraestrutura;
  • Bons conhecimentos de Microsoft Excel;
  • Experiência com tratamento e manipulação de dados;
  • Conhecimentos de SQL Query e/ou T-SQL;
  • Capacidade de organização e gestão autónoma do trabalho;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação com equipas técnicas e não técnicas.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Formação superior na área de Tecnologias de Informação;
  • Experiência em processos de access review e recertificação;
  • Experiência em processos JML;
  • Experiência de interação com auditores externos;
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados;
  • Contacto com equipas de Information Security.

Perfil comportamental

  • Autonomia e capacidade de priorização;
  • Atenção ao detalhe;
  • Orientação para processo e controlo;
  • Capacidade de comunicação entre diferentes equipas;
  • Interesse em aprendizagem contínua e evolução técnica.

raw.description:
ABOUT US

SCH Services provides centralized enterprise support across the SCH Capital Holdings, Inc. family of brands (SullivanCotter, Clinician Nexus, C3 Nonprofit Consulting Group & Lotis Blue). Through integrated expertise in finance and accounting, human resources, information technology, legal and compliance, marketing, administrative operations, and learning and development, the organization enables each operating company to focus on delivering exceptional client value while maintaining strong governance, operational excellence, and scalability.

Committed to aligning enterprise workforce capabilities with long-term business strategy, SCH leverages data-driven insights, AI-enabled frameworks, and collaborative partnerships with executive leadership and HR to drive measurable improvements in workforce productivity, employee engagement, and organizational readiness across its business units.

This is a remote role; however, we only operate in the following states: AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX and WI.

JOB SUMMARY

The Manager, Administrative Operations & Support Services leads a centralized, multi-disciplinary team within the organization's Administrative Operations Support Centers of Excellence (COE) framework. This role is accountable for delivering comprehensive administrative support to Shared Services functions and Professional Services consultants. The role is instrumental in facilitating efficient enterprise-wide administrative support coordination, maintaining seamless communication and operations, including support for senior executives with high-level administrative needs.

Given the organization's current size and growth trajectory, this is a true player/coach role. The Manager both leads the team and drives execution of high-priority initiatives, stepping in across service lines as needed. This individual combines strategic vision with a willingness to roll up their sleeves, setting the standard for the team through direct example.

Service areas under this role's stewardship span the full range of the firm's administrative support needs, including document production, research services, marketing support, executive calendaring, corporate travel, client contracting and Statement of Work (SOW) administration, and related administrative operations. This role reports to the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) within SCH Shared Services – Administrative Operations.

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Team Leadership & COE Operations

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and manage a team of administrative operations professionals supporting the enterprise
  • Partner with the Lead(s) to monitor service levels, timeliness, and team output quality, and collaborate on developing measures of success
  • Establish COE operating standards, service-level agreements (SLAs), and quality benchmarks
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, provide ongoing coaching, and build development plans aligned with individual career goals
  • Personally execute high-priority or complex work across any service line, functioning as an individual contributor when volume, urgency, or quality demands it
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, adaptability, and ownership at every level of the team
  • Foster a culture of proactiveness, accountability, and responsiveness across the team
  • Own the structure and ongoing development of COEs, including rosters, RACI matrices, and workstream coverage
  • Serve as the escalation point for cross-COE resourcing and prioritization decisions

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with consulting teams and enterprise leadership to align administrative support capacity with engagement needs
  • Ensure the team partners proactively with enterprise leaders and associates to remove administrative burden from their workload, enabling them to focus on client delivery and engagement success.
  • Collaborate with HR and operations leadership on staffing, policy, and organizational design matters affecting the operations support team
  • Build and maintain relationships with internal stakeholders across the firm to facilitate effective communication and service delivery
  • Represent the administrative workforce on firm-wide initiatives, committees, and cross-functional projects, ensuring the team's perspective and capacity are considered in decision-making
  • Identify and recommend operational improvements, including process, technology, and staffing model enhancements that increase efficiency and service quality across the support function
  • Uphold professional and technical standards in line with the firm's code of conduct, exercising discretion in handling confidential and sensitive information

Enterprise Contracting COE

  • Oversee the Contracting COE to ensure every SOW is tracked through to signature and completion following negotiation by the consulting team
  • Ensure new client and engagement setup is completed accurately across finance and operational systems to enable timely invoicing
  • Partner with legal, finance, and business stakeholders to ensure contract compliance
  • Oversee the Contracting COE to ensure processes are documented, standard templates and approval workflows are developed, and contract repository infrastructure is in place
  • Identify and implement process improvements that create scalable, repeatable workflows across the contracting lifecycle

Document Production COE

  • Oversee and contribute to the preparation, formatting, editing, and quality review of proposals, reports, presentations, contracts, and correspondence
  • Ensure all deliverables adhere to firm branding, formatting, and style standards, maintaining a consistent and professional presentation across client-facing and internal documents
  • Implement document management best practices, including version control, naming conventions, and template libraries

Research Services COE

  • Manage a centralized research support function providing consultants and shared services leaders with business intelligence, competitive data, and industry analysis

General Administrative COE

  • Oversee calendar management for senior leaders, shared services directors, and professional services engagement managers, implementing standardized scheduling protocols and priority-setting frameworks
  • Serve as liaison with Finance to support the Billing COE, ensuring timely invoicing and expense activities
  • Oversee the processing of expense reports for consultants and shared services staff in compliance with corporate policy
  • Identify and implement process improvements that create scalable, repeatable workflows across administrative support functions

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent experience considered
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in administrative services, operations, contracting/client services, or a combination of these disciplines
  • 5+ years of direct team management experience, ideally in a professional services or COE environment

Skills & Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive as a player/coach, balancing hands-on involvement with effective delegation, process improvement, and development of team expertise
  • Proficiency with enterprise productivity suites (Microsoft 365), client contracting platforms, and ERP or spend management systems
  • Actively builds fluency with data-driven productivity tools, applying them to improve drafting, editing, and analytical work
  • Strong project management skills; ability to manage competing priorities and deliver across multiple service lines simultaneously
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce and review contracts and executive-level materials
  • Analytical thinking applied to business process improvement and service optimization
  • Skilled at managing stakeholder relationships through strategic questioning and consultative problem-solving
  • Comfort embracing change and fostering a culture of inclusion across a growing team
  • A collaborative, service-oriented mindset with sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience managing dynamic, distributed teams
  • Experience in consulting or healthcare-related industries

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work location may be remote/hybrid. Minimal travel (<10%) required to support on-premise assets and in-person team meetings. Must be physically able to perform the essential functions of the job.

SALARY, BENEFITS AND PERKS

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Medical and dental coverage at no premium cost for employees
  • 401(k) and profit-sharing retirement plans
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Company-paid holidays
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Bereavement and pet leave
  • Continuing education and professional accreditation sponsorship
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Employee assistance program
  • Mental health support program
  • Additional perks

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to academic achievements, skills and experience. The range listed is just one component of the compensation package offered to candidates.

  • $100,700 - $167,800 annually

OUR VALUES IN ACTION: HOW WE CARE

We live our values daily through four commitments:

  • Connect:Collaborate selflessly to support others, advance ideas, and solve problems using critical thinking.
  • Act:Bring integrity and respect to every interaction—no exceptions.
  • Reach:Commit to continuous learning and knowledge sharing that strengthens teams and clients.
  • Embrace:Foster inclusion and belonging so everyone can thrive and contribute.

SullivanCotter Holdings, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law or marital status.

At LingoAid, we’re not just passionate about language—we’re on a mission to connect people, empower communities, and create understanding through the power of words. Our motto, "Unity in Understanding," drives everything we do. With a commitment to linguistic diversity and precision, we’re here to ensure every voice is heard.

About the Role

We’re seeking Remote Contract Interpreters to join our dynamic team. If you’re fluent in English and any other language, have a passion for helping others, and value professionalism and accuracy, this role is for you! As an interpreter, you’ll play a vital role in bridging communication gaps while providing a reliable, unbiased, and empathetic experience for those you assist.


What We’re Looking For
Must-Haves:

  • Fluency in English and any other language.

Bonus Points:

Prior experience as Over-the-Phone Interpreter (OPI) (is a plus, but not a dealbreaker!)

raw.description:
Part-Time: 12 hours/week

About Yaqeen Institute

Yaqeen is a nonprofit on a mission to pioneer Islamic research in creative, cutting-edge formats tailored to meet people where they are. We work to dismantle doubts through well-researched truths, nurture conviction by strengthening belief with practical, spiritual guidance, and inspire contribution by reviving our tradition of faithful changemakers, insha’Allah. We’re seeking like-minded professionals who embody Islamic values including sincerity, excellence, and compassion, and want to make a difference in the faith of people worldwide.

About the role

The Video Editor will transform raw footage into polished, compelling content optimized for digital platforms. This role involves working closely with the media production team to maintain consistent visual style, pacing, and storytelling. The editor will handle a variety of deliverables, including long-form episodes, short-form micro-content, and social media assets, ensuring all outputs align with brand guidelines and engage target audiences.

What you'll do

  • A. Editing & Post-Production
    • Edit long-form and short-form video content according to creative direction and deadlines.
    • Add motion graphics, captions, and lower thirds as needed.
    • Optimize audio levels, color grading, and transitions for professional quality.
  • B. Workflow & Collaboration
    • Manage project files, version control, and asset organization for efficient handoffs.
    • Collaborate with producers, designers, and other editors to incorporate feedback.
    • Stay updated on current editing trends and best practices for YouTube and social platforms.
  • C. Quality Assurance & Delivery
    • Ensure all edits meet technical specifications and platform requirements.
    • Deliver final files in required formats and aspect ratios for distribution.
    • Suggest creative improvements to enhance storytelling and viewer engagement.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience editing professional video content (portfolio or reel required).
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or similar NLE), After Effects (basic), and audio editing tools.
  • Strong sense of pacing, rhythm, and visual storytelling.
  • Familiarity with aspect ratios and formats for YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and communication skills.
  • Ability to take feedback constructively and work efficiently under tight deadlines.

Assignment

  • A video reel (1–2 minutes) highlighting your best editing work.
  • Editing Sample (choose one):
    • Option A: Provide a before-and-after edit sample—either a personal project or publicly available raw footage you’ve re-edited—to showcase your storytelling, pacing, and stylistic choices. Include a brief (100–150 words) explanation of your decisions and workflow.
    • Option B: Select any existing Yaqeen Institute video of your choice and re-edit a 30–60 second segment in your own unique style. Submit the re-edited clip along with a short note (100–150 words) explaining the creative choices you made and why. (Please include the original video link you used.)
  • Optional: A short note (2–3 sentences) about an editing trend or technique you’re excited to explore in future projects.

Yaqeen Institute embraces a philosophy that values and promotes diversity. Our goal is to attract, develop, retain, and advance a talented and diverse workforce within a culture where all employees are empowered to reach their fullest potential.

Please note that all career opportunities at Yaqeen Institute are subject to a three-month probationary period, during which we assess performance, alignment with our values, and mutual fit to ensure long-term success in the role.

raw.excerpt: Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives.
raw.description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
  • Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
  • Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
  • Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
  • Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
  • Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
  • Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
  • Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

  • Source qualified candidates through Indeed and various online job boards and recruitment platforms.
  • Search for candidates based on the requirements and qualifications provided by the client.
  • Review candidate profiles, resumes, and applications to identify potential matches.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for current openings.
  • Proactively identify candidates rather than relying solely on incoming applications.
  • Conduct initial screening of applicants based on job requirements and client criteria.
  • Review resumes and candidate backgrounds for relevant experience and qualifications.
  • Conduct preliminary phone or video interviews when required.

  • Review incoming applications and organize candidates according to the appropriate role or hiring stage.
  • Assist with updating job postings and sourcing strategies as needed.
  • Utilize different search methods and recruitment platforms to expand the candidate pool when necessary.
  • Maintain organized candidate records, resumes, screening notes, and interview schedules.
  • Track candidate progress from initial sourcing through interview and hiring.
  • Prepare recruitment reports or updates as requested.
  • Perform other recruitment-related administrative tasks to support the client's hiring efforts.

Hard Requirements:

  • Previous experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, recruitment coordination, or sourcing.
  • Hands-on experience sourcing candidates through Indeed and/or other online job platforms.
  • Experience reviewing resumes and screening candidates.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple open positions and candidate pipelines simultaneously.
  • Comfortable communicating directly with clients or hiring managers.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate record-keeping.
  • Proactive approach to candidate sourcing and follow-up.
  • Ability to work independently and meet recruitment targets and deadlines.

Schedule:

HOURS/WEEK:
  • 40 Hours/Week
  • Monday-Friday 9:00AM-6:00PM EST

Offer and Benefits:

  • Weeks 1–8: $5 USD/hour

raw.title: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling

raw.excerpt: About Nutrient• At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents.
raw.description:
About Nutrient

  • At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical.

Your Role at Nutrient...

We’re looking for a backend engineer passionate about building robust and scalable systems, excited about working with modern cloud technologies and distributed systems to power our Document Engine and SaaS products.

You find satisfaction in architecting high-performance solutions, optimising system reliability, caring for the cloud infrastructure our products run on, and creating efficient backend services that handle complex document processing workflows at scale.

What You'll Work On...

  • Execute on the design and implementation of high-performance Elixir/Phoenix-based systems such as Nutrient's Document Engine and Web Services API
  • Design and build declarative infrastructure, robust, scalable and easy to observe and maintain (we are currently using Terraform, Terramate and FluxCD on Kubernetes, with Helm charts powering both our managed cloud and customer self-hosted deployments)
  • Operate and evolve our managed cloud platform: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, GitOps workflows, observability, and database operations, keeping it reliable, secure, and costefficient
  • Share ownership for architecture, tools and services, contribute to product development and customer success
  • Collaborate closely with a small, remote-first engineering team to ship features, debug hard problems, and continuously improve reliability
  • Meet in person with the team periodically to align and reflect

What You'll Bring...

  • Experience in backend services and distributed systems
  • A track record running production workloads on Kubernetes and public cloud (we use AWS), ideally with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices
  • Strong coding skills: Elixir experience isn't required, we'll help you learn
  • A pragmatic approach to code: you appreciate clean architecture but know when good enough is the right call
  • A culture of direct feedback: you speak up when something isn't right and take feedback just as well

Who Thrives Here...

At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are:

  • Collaborators: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego.
  • Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth.
  • Curious Thinkers: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right.
  • Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence.
  • Owners: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control.
  • Doers: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges.

Why You'll Love Working Here...

At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centred on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact.

  • Real platform ownership: You’ll help run and evolve the managed cloud behind Document Engine (cluster lifecycle, GitOps, and observability), not just ship services on top of it.
  • Modern stack end to end: Elixir and Phoenix for the product, Kubernetes with Terraform, Helm, and FluxCD for the infrastructure it runs on.
  • Fully remote and async-first: Minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work.
  • Mission-critical product: Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%+ of the Global 500 across 80+ countries.
  • Strong growth trajectory: ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners, with a $100M+ investment fuelling further growth.

Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non-merit factor.

raw.description:
Are you a creator at heart?
Are you looking for a new opportunity in a collaborative, passionate, and global team?
Are you into listening to tons of business and marketing podcasts every day?

Great! Read on!

Lower Street is looking for a top-tier producer to join our incredible team.

Who are we?

Lower Street is a podcasting company that works with agencies, consultants, and enterprise companies to make amazing shows. Shows that matter, that make an impact.

We're focused on 2 things:

  1. Making the best podcasts we possibly can, and
  2. Continually learning and improving on what we do - both individually and as a team.

From concept to distribution, we help clients to develop their ideas into fully fledged podcasts. And it's really fun.

What’s the gig?

We’re looking for a producer to join our Production Team, and will work closely with folks like Elizabeth (Production Manager),Sam, Erin, and Marion (Executive Producers), and Alex (Head of Sound Design).

In this role, you’ll research, plan, script, and edit interview-based podcasts (no editing of audio, just words).

As a producer, you'll be helping to develop the show concept and format, coordinating with the clients to deliver audio and communicating feedback with them and the team, and managing the project internally.

But don't worry, you're not alone. We foster a collaborative culture and work together to make sure everything we produce is the absolute best it can be.

Things you'll do:

  • Researching subjects (often technical) and prepping interview plans for our hosts to produce weekly or bi-weekly episodes.
  • Coordinating recordings, audio files, session files, scripts and documents.
  • Editing tape, bringing episodes together (again, no audio editing involved in the role).
  • Writing interview prep sheets, narration scripts and coordinating with hosts to record them.
  • Writing show notes, blog posts, and sometimes social content.
  • Working with the sound designer on the creative direction of an episode and the final edit.
  • Coordinating with the client and managing other contributors from the Lower Street team to ensure projects are delivered.
  • Sourcing audio clips from external sources.
  • Occasionally booking and scheduling guests.

Who exactly are we looking for?

In short, does this sound like you? Someone that is:

  • Creative.You are able to foster and maintain the creative vision of the podcasts at LowerStreet.
  • Communicative.You have excellent written and verbal communication and excel in collaboration with teammates and our hosts.
  • Authentic.You put the people around you at ease and bring your own unique voice to research, writing, and scripting.
  • Adaptable.You thrive when you need to find solutions, make adjustments, and receive feedback. You work efficiently to get the job done by deadlines.
  • Passionate.You love storytelling and connecting business communities through content marketing.

Why you?

For this role, you ideally have:

  • Extensive experience writing B2B content.
  • The ability to listen to raw tape and pick out the most engaging, important, informative pieces to form a story that educates, inspires, and entertains the audience.
  • A talent for researching and understanding often complex topics and extracting their essential elements to tell a compelling story.
  • Script writing experience.
  • The ability to work to deadlines so that shows never miss schedule.
  • A critical eye and a close attention to detail.

Why Us?

  • Work from anywhere.
    • Your house in the country, a coffee shop in the city, a yurt in the forest -- we don’t mind. As long as you have strong enough wifi.
  • Truly great work culture.
    • We’re a young and small, but established company -- you can make a real impact, but we’re not in the business of micromanagement.
  • Flexible Hours.
    • Outside of ideally having some working overlap with UK working hours, we have a globally distributed, asynchronous team.
  • Generous PTO, sick leave, and public holiday policy.
    • Just throw us some notice and share where you go on holiday!
  • Equipment Budget.
    • Headphones, software, staplers, fax machine (probably not that last one) -- whatever you need to be set up for success.
  • Professional Development Allowance.
    • Courses, conference tickets, books -- we’re invested in you.
  • Planned team retreats in really fun spots.
    • Once a year, we get together in person to collaborate and celebrate.

Like what you see?

If you’re thinking: “This is totally me!” then be sure to apply below. Even if you’re thinking: “This definitely could be me!” apply anyways — we love diverse and non-traditional backgrounds.

Please, sneak the word ‘Cucumber’ somewhere into your application to show us you read the whole job description.

We do receive all applications here, please do not apply through the Contact Us form on the website, thank you!

*Please note, this is a rolling application and we are not necessarily actively hiring for a Producer at this time*

Project Coordinator (Project Coordination & Operations)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Project Coordinator to bring structure, accountability, and visibility across multiple projects and operational workflows.

This is more than an administrative role. You’ll work closely with project managers, leadership, vendors, and internal teams to keep projects on track by managing timelines, coordinating communication, maintaining documentation, and ensuring deliverables are completed on time.

Responsibilities

Project Planning & Coordination

  • Maintain project plans using Asana, Trello, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar tools.
  • Track timelines, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and project status.
  • Monitor progress and proactively escalate delays or risks.
  • Help teams stay aligned on priorities and deadlines.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Prepare meeting agendas, notes, action items, and project status reports.
  • Maintain organized documentation in Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, or Notion.
  • Track project progress, risks, blockers, and operational updates.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Coordinate communication between project managers, leadership, internal teams, vendors, and external stakeholders.
  • Follow up on tasks, approvals, and deadlines.
  • Ensure clear communication and accountability throughout the project lifecycle.

Task & Resource Management

  • Monitor task completion, dependencies, workloads, and scheduling conflicts.
  • Ensure deliverables remain on track and nothing falls through the cracks.

Risk & Quality Support

  • Identify bottlenecks, overdue tasks, and operational risks.
  • Maintain risk logs and support quality control before deliverables are completed.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in project coordination, operations support, or administrative/project support.
  • Hands-on experience with Asana, Trello, Monday.com, ClickUp, or similar platforms.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and trackers.
  • Excellent organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Strong follow-up, accountability, and time management.
  • Comfortable working remotely across multiple stakeholders and time zones.

Nice to Have

  • PMP, CAPM, Agile, or Scrum certification (or in progress).
  • Experience supporting SaaS, marketing, professional services, construction, or operations-focused businesses.
  • Familiarity with Agile workflows and KPI reporting.

What Success Looks Like

  • Projects stay organized and on schedule.
  • Timely completion of milestones and deliverables.
  • Clear, accurate project reporting and documentation.
  • Early identification and escalation of risks.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder alignment.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Task (Project Tracker & Status Report)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Product Manager, Bronchoscopes is responsible for the management of Fujifilm’s bronchoscope portfolio as it relates to both upstream and downstream activities and will report directly to the Senior Product Manager & Strategic Business Development Manager of Pulmonary. This key contributor must work cross-functionally within the organization and effectively with external stakeholders (e.g., Key Opinion Leaders) to execute company initiatives and manage all aspects of product commercialization. They must be a change agent in the evolution of the organization as new products, procedure types, and business methods gain adoption.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and responsibilities

  • Responsible for leading and managing all aspects of Fujifilm’s bronchoscope and endobronchial ultrasound portfolios, and working cross-functionally with various stakeholders internally and externally (e.g., healthcare professionals, sales & field personnel, global R&D, operations, regulatory, global marketing, other companies/device manufacturers, etc.)
  • Develop and drive 3 – 5 year strategic plans (e.g., product portfolio, commercialization plan, marketing plan, clinical plan, financial forecast plan and supply chain plan) for Fujifilm’s bronchoscope portfolio as well as develop the potential for synergistic devices and strategic partnerships to broaden adoption and market share for Fujifilm’s products.
  • Lead market assessment, commercialization and all required activities throughout their product life cycle, including but not limited to initial strategic assessment of the respective opportunities, competitive landscape, pre-release preparation, evaluation, launch, training, post-launch observations/trouble shooting, and product retirement.
  • Partner with broader team as it relates to downstream initiatives (i.e. product launch, product demonstrations, product subject matter expert, etc.)
  • Develop, build and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the marketplace. Activities include delivering various presentations, conducting site-visits, attending shows and conferences, inquiry handling, etc. Partner with global marketing to identify appropriate KOLs that could support new product development and provide valuable feedback on products and market (i.e. coordinate clinical labs and office/conference evaluations for new products with KOL and global marketing teams).
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Sales teams by supporting clinical demos and developing tactical plans to drive adoption and commercial success.
  • Serve as subject matter expert to provide clinical, technical, and market knowledge in the product franchise(s): which includes but is not limited to Fujifilm’s products and services, peripheral and competitors’ offerings, clinical and technology trends.
  • Take an active role in leadingfuture pipeline discussions together with other product management members, international headquarter liaisons, R&D, and marketing personnel. Stay solution-focused and positively suggest product improvements and innovation.
  • Work closely with global marketing and R&D counterparts to share best practices and leverage successes in other regions.
  • Partner with sales/sales leadership, national business development managers, clinical specialist team, and field service engineers in the management of field initiatives.
  • Primary lead for pulmonary portfolio and manage overall elements of trade show participation with regards to show objectives, booth and partnership equipment requirements, hands-on workshops, and overall execution of an event.
  • Serve as subject matter expert/technical resource to healthcare professionals and internal staff who have technical questions or problems. Communicate expert opinions on behalf of company products and offer possible solutions to the problems. Technical assistance should reflect functionality of the Fujifilm products as well as the intended clinical benefits and utility of these products in a given procedure(s).
  • Lead training on product operations, reprocessing, and manufacturer’s requirements of the portfolio.
  • Lead creation of the product evaluation protocol for new products and the evaluation on-site. This includes managing the site selection process, tactical protocol deliverables, and summarization of project results to global headquarters.
  • Develop tactics to drive adoption and broader recognition of clinical and economic benefits of Fujifilm technology (i.e. clinical as well as white paper strategy).

Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree is required, preferably with a degree related to healthcare or biology or business or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 7 years’ work experience in a marketing capacity (i.e., product marketing, marketing associate, associate product manager, product manager, senior product manager, product/technical director).
  • Minimum 5 years of medical device experience with strong clinical background.
  • Prior experience with endoscopes and/or pulmonology/endobronchial ultrasound preferred.
  • Highly focused and results-oriented; able to identify goals and priorities and resolve issues in initial stages.
  • Works with a sense of urgency, understands business expectations and maintains focus on the changing needs of the organization.
  • Experience leading new product trainings to include technology, disease state, clinical and economic messaging
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a close team environment, self-starter who can motivate others.
  • Proficient in managing through influence.
  • Exceptional communication/interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient computer skills using Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.
  • Effective Time Management skills.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret essential job-related documents.
  • Ability to present and speak effectively and professionally to all internal and external customers.
  • Ability to calculate, balance, analyze sales and marketing data, prepare detailed reports, and report data.
  • Ability to present and communicate in multi-cultural environment.
  • Knowledge / familiarity with general, thoracic, and/or, pulmonology related products and procedures is desired.
  • Knowledge of United States healthcare systems and dynamics is desired

Physical requirements

  • The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk, and hear for 75% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to lift and carry up to fifty pounds up to 10% of applicable work time.
  • Close Vision: The ability to see clearly at twenty inches or less.

Travel

  • Availability to frequently travel, including evenings and weekends.
  • Ability to travel up to 60% of time. Largely domestic but some international travel may be required.
  • Possess valid driver’s license.

Salary and Benefits:

  • $93,428-$132,000
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k

*

In the event that COVID-19 vaccine mandates issued by the federal government, or by state or local government become effective and enforceable, the Company will require that the successful candidate hired for positions covered under relevant government vaccine mandate(s) be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, absent being granted an accommodation due to medical or sincerely held religious belief or other legally required exemption. Applicants to positions where vendor credentialing or other similar requirements exist to enter facilities will be required to comply with the credentialing requirements of the facilities, including complying with vaccine requirements. For all positions, the Company encourages vaccination against COVID-19 and requires that the successful candidate hired be willing to test for the COVID-19 virus periodically and wear a face covering indoors as required, absent being granted an accommodation due to medical or sincerely held religious belief or other legally required exemption.

EEO Information

Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc.

ADA Information

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR Department ( or (330) 425-1313).

Help injured clients keep more of their settlement.

The Ward Law Group is seeking an experienced Personal Injury Lien Resolution Associate to negotiate medical balances and help move settled cases toward disbursement. If you enjoy negotiation, take ownership of your files, and know how to keep a high-volume caseload moving, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful difference for clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Negotiate hospital liens and medical provider balances under attorney supervision and firm procedures.
  • Review medical bills, verify outstanding balances, and obtain supporting documentation.
  • Submit reduction requests, follow up consistently, and obtain written confirmation of negotiated agreements.
  • Maintain accurate records of balances, negotiations, agreements, and case status in Litify.
  • Coordinate with attorneys and closing staff to resolve outstanding items and prepare files for settlement disbursement.
  • Meet expectations for negotiated reductions, turnaround times, productivity, and accuracy.
  • Refer legal questions and disputed liens requiring legal analysis to the appropriate attorney.

What You Bring

  • At least two years of hands-on plaintiff personal injury reductions experience supporting a U.S. law firm.
  • Direct experience negotiating with hospitals and medical providers, with the ability to explain your strategies and results.
  • Experience independently managing a high-volume reductions caseload from balance verification through written agreements and closing coordination.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with legal case management software and the ability to work independently in a remote environment; Litify experience preferred.

Remote Engagement Details

  • Independent contractor remote position
  • 40-hour workweek; schedule confirmed during the interview process.
  • Reliable internet, a computer, and a quiet, professional workspace required.
  • No employee benefits or paid time off.
  • Please submit your resume in English

  • Minimum 2 year of recent personal injury reductions, liens, or medical bill negotiation experience.
  • Experience handling hospital reductions and negotiating directly with medical providers and collection entities.
  • Experience working in a plaintiff personal injury law firm; Litify experience preferred.

Join Our Team

Apply today and become part of a team committed to excellence, accountability, and changing lives—one client at a time.

The Ward Law Group is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at The Ward Law Group via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from The Ward Law Group HR/Recruitment will be deemed the sole property of The Ward Law Group. At The Ward Law Group, we recognize our people are our strength. We value our people, their varying perspectives and are committed to fostering an environment where they can bring their whole selves to work.

In accordance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, employment is contingent upon verification of identity and authorization to work in the United States. All persons hired will be required to complete Form I-9 and provide acceptable documentation as required by law.

Join an Award-Winning Personal Injury Law Firm

At The Ward Law Group, our mission is simple:

Changing Lives. One Client at a Time

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for consecutive years, we are committed to delivering exceptional legal representation while creating an environment where talented professionals can grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact every day.

We believe our people are our greatest asset. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-accountability culture where every team member is empowered to make informed decisions, continuously improve, and deliver exceptional results for our clients. Every role contributes directly to helping injured individuals navigate one of the most challenging times in their lives while supporting the continued growth and success of our firm.

Our Core Values

Faith – We act with integrity, honesty, and purpose in everything we do.

Accountability – We take ownership of our work, our commitments, and the results we deliver.

Leadership – We lead by example, inspire others, embrace continuous improvement, and develop high-performing teams.

Service to Our Clients – We are committed to delivering compassionate, responsive, and exceptional service that maximizes every client's opportunity for success.

Service to Our Community – We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace by serving and strengthening the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about helping injured clients, thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment, and are committed to delivering exceptional client service while continuously growing your career, we invite you to join The Ward Law Group and help us change lives—one client at a time.
