✨ Join Toon Boom – Where Creativity and Technology Meet!

For over 30 years, Toon Boom has been the global leader in 2D animation software, trusted by top studios like Disney, Fox, and Netflix. With innovation at our core, we empower creatives worldwide to bring their stories to life.

As the animation industry evolves, Toon Boom is at the forefront of innovation. We have recently introduced Ember, a new AI-powered feature set within Harmony, purpose-built for Japan’s frame-by-frame animation workflows. Unlike standalone AI tools, Ember integrates seamlessly into existing production pipelines, ensuring artists retain full creative control.

With strong early adoption and enthusiastic feedback from leading Japanese studios, Toon Boom is entering a critical growth phase in Japan. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of 2D animation in the world’s most influential animation market—combining proven production tools with next-generation AI capabilities.

🌍 Work Location

This is a 100% remote position based in Japan, hired under our Toon Boom Japan legal entity. While there is no physical office requirement for this role, you must be based in Tokyo to be eligible for this position.

🤩 What you'll do

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, the Japan Country Manager will lead Toon Boom’s business in Japan with full ownership of market strategy, revenue growth, and local operations. This role is both strategic and hands-on, requiring a leader who can build strategy, drive market expansion, build deep industry relationships, and position Toon Boom as the leading platform for modern animation production in Japan.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for managing and growing Toon Boom’s business in Japan, including with full P&L responsibility and accountability for revenue targets, pipeline development, and market share expansion.
  • Define and execute a localized go-to-market strategy across direct sales, partnerships, and customer success.
  • Build and expand relationships with leading animation studios, acting as executive sponsor on key accounts and leading complex enterprise negotiations.
  • Drive adoption of Toon Boom’s Ember AI features, educating the market on AI-assisted workflows while respecting established production practices.
  • Expand Toon Boom’s footprint within existing customers while securing new studio, broadcaster, and enterprise clients.
  • Develop and manage a partner ecosystem, including resellers, strategic alliances, and educational institutions.
  • Lead and scale the Japan-based team across sales, support, and marketing functions as the business grows.
  • Act as the voice of the Japanese market internally, providing insights that influence product roadmap, localization, pricing, and global strategy.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (Montreal HQ across marketing, product, customer success, revenue operations, finance, and people) to align execution and accelerate growth.

🎯 What you'll need

  • 15+ years of experience in the Japanese animation industry and/or animation software ecosystem.
  • Deep network and credibility with Japanese animation studios, producers, and production leaders.
  • Strong understanding of frame-by-frame animation workflows and production pipelines in Japan.
  • Proven experience working with North American or European companies, ideally in a leadership or market-facing role.
  • Demonstrated success in building and executing go-to-market strategies, and leading sales and/or cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing enterprise sales cycles and high-value negotiations.
  • Strong strategic mindset with the ability to operate both at a high level and in a hands-on capacity.
  • Fluency in Japanese and English, with a deep understanding of Japanese business culture and practices.
  • Post-secondary education in business, computer science, or a related field is preferred.

🤩 Why Join Toon Boom

  • You will lead expansion in one of the world's most important and influential animation markets.
  • You will work with globally recognized studios and iconic IP.
  • You will help define how AI is integrated into professional animation workflows, not replace them.
  • You will operate with true ownership and influence as the leader of the Japan market.
  • You will be part of a company combining industry legacy with cutting-edge innovation!

🤝 What to expect during the recruitment process

At Toon Boom, we believe in a transparent and respectful experience. Here’s what to expect:

  • HR Interview: If there’s alignment, we’ll schedule a video call to discuss your background and answer your questions.
  • Meet the Team: Next, you’ll meet your manager and key team members to learn more about the team.
  • Accessible and Inclusive: We are committed to a fair and accessible process. Let us know if you need any accommodations.

🩷 Embracing Diversity & Inclusion

At Toon Boom, we embrace diversity in its fullest form. Our commitment is to create a safe and inclusive environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work. We believe in the strength and innovation that come from diverse experiences and perspectives.

Role: Clinical Research Associate (CRA) - Cardiovascular Medical Device

Location: Remote

Position Summary:

Assist with the management of cardiovascular clinical studies for MiRus products with a focus on adherence to critical timelines, high-caliber document development and quality data collection. The applicant should possess strong critical thinking skills and the ability to comprehend technical subject matter to effectively contribute to the organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to content generation, writing and editing of study protocols, amendments, informed consents, committee charters, study reports, monitoring plans, and other related clinical and regulatory documents.
  • Assist with the management of investigational studies from start through study closure.
  • Engage in new study trial design with cross functional teams, including clinical and pre-clinical research and development groups.
  • Contribute to the development of CRFs
  • Assist with the formulation of instructional materials and training of investigators, study coordinators and associated study site personnel on the conduct of the clinical trials, as applicable.
  • Assist Study Manager with safety monitoring including preparing supporting documentation for CEC and/or DSMB, meetings, agenda, data review, presentations, and updating relevant trackers as applicable.
  • Serve as a point of contact between clinical site investigators and the MiRus team.
  • Work with investigators and site personnel to quickly and effectively resolve discrepancies.
  • May be responsible for patient accruals and tracking payments to sites for clinical study programs
  • Serve as a point of contact between CRO personnel and MiRus.
  • Oversee/support CRO and field study monitors, with monitoring related items and follow-up on study tasks.
  • Monitor ongoing compliance to study protocols in accordance with applicable regulations and GCP, work instructions, guidelines and/or policies.
  • Provide continuous data review of source documents, case report forms, data reports as appropriate.
  • Assist in review of monitoring reports and tracking of action items.
  • Review source documentation to confirm subject eligibility for clinical trials.
  • Track and upload study imaging
  • Manage clinical study documentation (trial master file and study related tracking).
  • Update and design as needed study dashboards, study trackers and other applicable study documents to provide regular updates on trial status to Study Manager
  • Interact with data management, as applicable
  • Support applications and technical files as needed.
  • Assist with preparation for investigators meetings.

Minimum Education and/or Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in nursing with clinical experience in the cardiac field (CCU, CVOR, Cath Lab) and experience in a clinical research role. CRA certification desired.
  • At least 2 years of experience in clinical research role, with at least 2 years in CRA role, preferably in cardiovascular medical device.
  • Experience in clinical trials and/or post-market registries in the U.S., Australian and/or European Union, with other geographies desired.
  • Current knowledge of medical device clinical trials design and best practices.
  • Proficient knowledge of FDA regulations and ICH/GCP guidelines, guidance documents, and other applicable regulations and standards, and implementation of these standards in the medical device industry, in the U.S. and all countries in which trials are conducted.
  • General application of medical terminology (cardiovascular specific preferred).

  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account or Health Savings Account
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off

Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday (8am – 5pm)

Work Location:

  • Remote
  • Position may require domestic travel at least 20-40%

raw.excerpt: We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on VoIP/VTC Solution Engineering Manager to lead our Unified Communications and Collaboration (UC&C) Solution Engineering team.
raw.description:
We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on VoIP/VTC Solution Engineering Manager to lead our Unified Communications and Collaboration (UC&C) Solution Engineering team. Reporting directly to the Director of Digital Engineering, this position is primarily accountable for people leadership, engineering quality, resource planning, and the successful delivery of the team's technical commitments.

This is a people-management role with significant hands-on technical leadership responsibilities. The manager will supervise, mentor, and develop a team of approximately four Solution Engineers while remaining actively engaged in solution architecture, design reviews, complex implementations, and Tier 3/Tier 4 engineering escalations.

As a Level T5 leader, the manager will serve as the domain technical authority for assigned enterprise voice, video teleconferencing (VTC), telephony, and collaboration solutions. The position will partner closely with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program leadership, customers, and vendor partners to establish engineering standards, modernize legacy telephony environments, and architect secure, resilient, and supportable on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-based collaboration solutions.


Key Responsibilities


1. People and Team Leadership

  • Team Management: Directly supervise, coach, and manage a team of approximately four VoIP, VTC, and Telephony Solution Engineers.
  • Performance and Career Development: Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, establish measurable performance objectives, complete annual performance reviews, identify training needs, and guide employee career development.
  • Workload and Capacity Planning: Prioritize projects and engineering tasks, balance workloads across team members, assign technical leads, and ensure the timely delivery of engineering commitments.
  • Staffing and Succession Planning: Forecast staffing requirements, identify technical skill gaps, develop succession and cross-training plans, and maintain appropriate engineering coverage.
  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Lead technical interviews, candidate evaluations, hiring recommendations, and onboarding activities.
  • Team Culture: Foster a high-performing, collaborative, accountable, and inclusive engineering culture that encourages technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

2. Engineering Delivery and Governance

  • Delivery Management: Own the engineering quality, technical execution, schedules, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations associated with the team's assigned work.
  • Engineering Lifecycle: Ensure solutions progress through documented requirements, alternatives analysis, architecture, detailed design, design review, laboratory validation, implementation planning, acceptance testing, configuration control, and transition to operations.
  • Engineering Documentation: Ensure the development and maintenance of high-level and low-level designs, bills of material, test plans, implementation procedures, rollback plans, configuration baselines, and as-built documentation.
  • Operational Readiness: Confirm that new or modified solutions are secure, supportable, monitored, documented, resilient, and ready for operational ownership before deployment or transition.
  • Standards and Compliance: Establish and enforce engineering design standards, approved product and configuration baselines, Quality of Service (QoS) requirements, cybersecurity controls, and disaster recovery and business continuity requirements.
  • Performance Reporting: Establish and communicate meaningful measures for engineering backlog, milestone delivery, design quality, lifecycle risk, operational readiness, and recurring technical issues.

3. Technical Leadership and Architecture

  • Solution Architecture: Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and architectural authority for assigned enterprise voice, VTC, SIP trunking, Session Border Controller (SBC), telephony, and collaboration solutions.
  • Technical Roadmaps: Develop and maintain technical roadmaps for modernizing legacy PBX and telephony environments and transitioning to appropriate on-premises, hybrid, UCaaS, and cloud collaboration platforms.
  • Enterprise Telephony Engineering: Provide technical direction for enterprise dial plans, E.164 number normalization, digit manipulation, call routing, SIP trunking, carrier interconnections, PSTN services, voice gateways, voicemail, and emergency calling capabilities.
  • Availability and Resiliency: Define technical requirements for high availability, geographic redundancy, survivability, disaster recovery, capacity management, and service continuity.
  • Technology Evaluation: Lead product evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, interoperability testing, and technical risk assessments for new voice, video, and collaboration technologies.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate closely with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program leadership, customers, and vendor partners to align collaboration solutions with enterprise infrastructure, security, and operational requirements.
  • Vendor and Carrier Coordination: Lead technical engagements and escalations involving equipment manufacturers, software providers, telecommunications carriers, SIP service providers, and system integrators.

4. Hands-On Technical Engineering and Escalation

  • Design and Deployment: Perform and oversee the configuration, integration, testing, and deployment of IP telephony systems, SIP proxies, SBCs—including AudioCodes, Ribbon, and Cisco CUBE—and unified communications platforms.
  • VTC Engineering: Architect, integrate, configure, and troubleshoot multi-vendor VTC and audiovisual collaboration environments, including Cisco Room Series and Webex devices, Poly, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Crestron, and Zoom Rooms.
  • Cloud Voice Integration: Design and support integrations between on-premises voice infrastructure and cloud collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams Phone, Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Webex Calling, and comparable services.
  • Engineering Escalation: Serve as the senior engineering escalation point for complex voice and video incidents involving call routing, signaling, media negotiation, interoperability, packet loss, jitter, latency, one-way audio, call quality, or service availability.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Lead technical investigations, identify underlying causes, develop permanent corrective actions, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into standards, designs, and operating procedures.
  • QoS and Transport Optimization: Collaborate with Transport and Network Engineering to design and validate end-to-end QoS, including traffic classification and marking using DSCP and Layer 2 CoS, queuing, shaping, policing, call admission control, bandwidth planning, and class-of-service mapping across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and carrier transport services.
  • Monitoring and Service Assurance: Support the implementation and use of monitoring, alerting, call-quality analytics, call-detail records, capacity reporting, and trend analysis for enterprise voice and video services.

Required Experience and Education

  • Professional Experience: Ten or more years of progressive engineering experience in VoIP, VTC, enterprise telephony, unified communications, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Leadership Experience: At least three years of technical leadership experience, including formal supervisory or people-management responsibilities such as staffing, performance management, employee development, and workload assignment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent relevant education, certifications, and practical experience may be considered.

Preferred Technical Proficiencies

  • VoIP and Telephony Protocols: Advanced knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP/RTCP, SRTP, H.323, MGCP, ISDN/PRI, and related voice and video signaling and media protocols.
  • Call-Control Platforms: Proven experience with enterprise platforms such as Cisco Unified Communications Manager, Cisco Unity Connection, Microsoft Teams Phone, or comparable on-premises and cloud-based call-control systems.
  • Dial Plans and Carrier Services: Experience with enterprise dial-plan architecture, E.164 numbering, digit manipulation, SIP trunks, PSTN connectivity, carrier interconnections, voice gateways, and emergency calling.
  • VTC and Collaboration Systems: Extensive experience designing, integrating, and deploying enterprise video collaboration systems, including Cisco, Poly, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms, Crestron, or comparable platforms.
  • Session Border Controllers: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise SBCs such as AudioCodes Mediant, Ribbon SBC, Oracle Communications Session Border Controller/Acme Packet, and Cisco CUBE.
  • Cloud and Hybrid Voice: Experience integrating on-premises telephony with cloud collaboration services, including Microsoft Teams Direct Routing and Operator Connect, Webex Calling, or comparable platforms.
  • Network and QoS Analysis: Strong knowledge of IP networking, routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, Network Address Translation, SIP and media traversal, packet-capture analysis, QoS policy design, and bandwidth and capacity planning.
  • Security and Identity: Working knowledge of SIP TLS, mutual TLS, SRTP, certificates and PKI, directory services, identity integration, secure configuration baselines, vulnerability remediation, and change and configuration management.
  • Troubleshooting Tools: Demonstrated ability to use Wireshark, platform traces, SBC logs, call-detail records, monitoring systems, and other diagnostic tools to isolate complex signaling, media, network, and interoperability problems.

Leadership and Communication Skills

  • Ability to balance people leadership, engineering delivery, technical governance, and hands-on technical contribution.
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills, including the ability to prioritize competing requirements and manage technical and delivery risks.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations to engineers, customers, program leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to establish expectations, communicate constraints, and resolve technical or organizational issues.
  • Proven problem-solving ability and experience leading teams through complex, high-pressure operational or engineering situations.
  • Commitment to employee development, knowledge sharing, process improvement, and engineering excellence.

Preferred Certifications and Qualifications

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional Collaboration or Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Collaboration.
  • Current Microsoft certification related to collaboration communications systems, Microsoft Teams Phone, or an equivalent voice and collaboration technology.
  • Current AudioCodes, Ribbon, Cisco, Microsoft, or comparable voice and collaboration certification.
  • Experience developing technical proposals, statements of work, bills of material, level-of-effort estimates, staffing plans, or technical risk assessments.
  • Experience with automation and scripting for telephony administration and provisioning using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, or comparable technologies.

Experience supporting large-scale, geographically distributed, highly available, or mission-critical voice and video environments.

Real Estate Closing Coordinator – Transaction Coordination | Remote, PST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40 Hours/Week)
Location: Remote
Working Hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM PST

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Real Estate Closing Coordinator to support high-volume residential real estate transactions from offer through closing.

This is a fast-paced, execution-focused role where you’ll work closely with agents to manage offers, addendums, inspections, transaction documentation, deadlines, and closing coordination.

If you have real estate transaction experience, are highly responsive, and know how to keep multiple deals organized and moving forward, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Transaction & Closing Coordination

  • Support agents throughout the transaction and closing process
  • Assist with drafting offers, purchase agreements, addendums, and transaction documents
  • Coordinate inspections and required follow-ups
  • Track transaction milestones, deadlines, and closing progress
  • Ensure documents and transaction records remain accurate and organized
  • Help prevent delays by proactively following up on outstanding items

Agent & Operational Support

  • Respond quickly to agent requests throughout the day
  • Help agents manage transactions efficiently during high-volume periods
  • Coordinate administrative and operational tasks associated with active deals
  • Maintain strong responsiveness during PST business hours

Communication & Follow-Up

  • Communicate professionally through email, text, and Slack
  • Coordinate with agents, clients, and other transaction stakeholders
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding documentation and next steps
  • Keep relevant parties informed throughout the transaction lifecycle

CRM & Transaction Systems

  • Maintain accurate records in CRM and transaction management systems
  • Manage documentation and workflows within DocuSign Rooms
  • Keep transaction files complete, organized, and accessible
  • Maintain accurate internal tracking and status updates

Requirements

  • Experience in real estate transaction coordination, closing coordination, real estate operations, or related administrative support
  • Familiarity with:
    • Offer drafting
    • Purchase agreements and addendums
    • Inspections
    • Transaction timelines
    • Closing coordination
  • Experience using DocuSign Rooms, CRM systems, Slack, and Google Workspace
  • Ability to manage multiple active transactions and deadlines simultaneously
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Fast, reliable communication and follow-through
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment
  • Must be available 9:00 AM–6:00 PM PST
  • Flexibility for occasional after-hours support when transaction volume requires it

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based residential real estate teams
  • High-volume transaction coordination experience
  • Startup or fast-growth company experience
  • Strong understanding of residential real estate workflows from offer through close

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate and complete transaction documentation
  • No missed milestones or critical follow-ups
  • Fast response times to agent requests
  • Organized and up-to-date transaction records
  • Smooth progression of transactions toward closing
  • Fewer operational delays and closing issues
  • Strong agent and internal team satisfaction

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re experienced in real estate transactions, closing coordination, DocuSign Rooms, offer preparation, and deadline management and thrive in a fast-moving environment, we’d love to hear from you.

One80 Intermediaries is seeking a Risk Management Services Associate to join our growing team.


The Risk Management Services Associate provides support across Claims, Loss Control, and Risk Analytics. The role assists with claims administration, client reporting, data management, risk financing analysis, and loss control activities while working collaboratively with account teams to support client risk management programs.


How You Will Contribute:  

  • Perform the business impact strategy directly with customers, one-on-one, while carrying out loss control and/or claim duties, exercising independent judgment in advising customers on how to improve their risk profile.
  • Assist in reporting new losses to insurance carriers and third-party administrators.
  • Support Claim Advocates with claim documentation, correspondence, file maintenance, data entry, and preparation of claim review materials.
  • Assist the Analytics team with collecting, organizing, validating, and standardizing claims and risk management data received from multiple carriers, third-party administrators, account teams, and other sources.
  • Support the development, testing, maintenance, and continuous improvement of recurring and ad hoc client dashboards, risk financing analyses, reports, presentations, and related analytics processes.
  • Assist the Loss Control team with document management and data entry.
  • Working knowledge of construction projects/builder risk.
  • Learn OSHA regulations for general industry, loss control “best practices” and workers compensation programs is required
  • The position requires the consultant to be initiative-taking and work well without close supervision. The individual must be able to make decisions with and without established guidelines and to provide technical support to customers, brokers, and underwriters
  • The position requires excellent people skills (verbal and written) and provides a customer-focused approach.

Skills & Experience to be Successful: 

  • Knowledge of or interest in commercial lines insurance, claims, loss control, and risk management.
  • Ability to learn and apply insurance terminology, basic claims and risk financing concepts, and coverage structures in support of reporting and analysis.
  • Ability to translate data and analytical findings into clear and concise business insights.
  • Ability to work with large datasets and perform basic data analysis, reconciliation, and quality-control activities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across Claims, Loss Control, Analytics, and account management teams.
  • Experience with or interest in Power BI, data visualization, and business intelligence tools.
  • Familiarity with basic data concepts, including structured datasets, tables, relationships, and unique identifiers, preferred.
  • Familiarity with Power Query, data transformation, or similar ETL tools preferred.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Ability to provide superior customer service.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and recurring deadlines.

About One80:

One80 Intermediaries is part of Arrowhead Intermediaries, a global insurance distribution platform that offers deep specialization, scale, and innovation across wholesale brokerage, program administration, and specialty insurance. With more than 7,000 professionals worldwide and a collective portfolio exceeding $18 billion in premium placed in 2024, our combined organization delivers a diverse trading platform for insurance carriers as well as expanded access and niche solutions for brokers and customers navigating complex and hard-to-place risks. The platform combines entrepreneurial culture with operational excellence to deliver tailored solutions and long-term value across the insurance ecosystem.

80,000.00 - 80,000.00 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

raw.description:
Position Description

The SCADA Controls Engineer will work with the SCADA Engineering team and project managers. Responsible for integrating real-time Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) and computer systems at electric power generation plants, including utility-scale solar power, wind power, and battery storage. Typical devices include RTUs, PLCs, SCADA systems, Plant Control Systems, electric power meters, and meteorological (MET) data loggers.

This position may be filled as a level 1, 2, 3, Senior, or Lead, depending upon the knowledge, skills, and experience of the selected candidate. The posted salary range reflects the reasonably anticipated range that might apply to offers made across those levels.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of automation projects from conception to completion.
  • Develop and grow new technical service areas related to SEL RTACs.
  • Document and implement logic and control schemes for remote and local operation of power system equipment
  • Develop programs for the implementation of Remedial Action Schemes, PV Solar, Battery Energy Storage Systems, Microgrid, Renewable Curtailment, Volt/Var Control, Load Shedding, Anti-Islanding, and other custom logic.
  • Develop and implement innovative solutions to automate complex processes.
  • Establish and maintain best practices and guidelines for automation and control systems.
  • Provide leadership and direction to engineering teams, enhancing skill development.
  • Lead design and implementation of complex SCADA systems.
  • Coordinate large project teams and manage project timelines and budgets.
  • Conduct high-level troubleshooting and system diagnostics.
  • Develop and standardize SCADA protocols and best practices.
  • Collaborate with other departments for system integration and enhancements.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field and at least two years of experience with SCADA systems or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Expertise in SEL AcSELerator for RTAC, CODESYS, and Python.
  • 2+ years’ relevant experience in working with SEL RTAC 33XX and 35XX SCADA systems utilizing IEC 61131 structured text programming.
  • 2+ years of experience in Relaying, Planning, Substation, Information Technology, or Distribution design, construction, or operations preferred.
  • Profound understanding of network architecture and cybersecurity.
  • Strong leadership and team coordination skills.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Advanced technical writing and documentation abilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management.

Physical, Mental & Emotional Requirements

Employee may be required to sit for long periods of time using a keyboard and monitor display, travel to other locations, lift up to 20lbs, and push/pull up to 50lbs. Must be able to organize and prioritize work in accordance with deadlines, adapt behavior and work methods in response to changing conditions or challenges. Employee will be involved with sustained activity required for analysis, reasoning, and problem solving. Must be able to develop and maintain cooperative working relationships, recognize emotionally charged issues and respond appropriately, act with professionalism, and work both independently and collaboratively. Must be able to proactively encourage a work environment that encourages innovation and creative solutions and be able to develop effective working relationships with all levels of the company and outside partners.

Work Environment

The employee will primarily work in a climate-controlled office with occasional fluctuations in temperature. The employee will work at an assigned desk under artificial lighting. The employee may occasionally attend meetings and/or training outside of their assigned workstation. They may occasionally perform work remotely in the environment of their choosing. Employee may be required to perform some travel.

Salary: $115,000 - $175,000 per year, depending upon experience and level

Summary/Objective:

The PLH Medical Lead position is responsible for being a clinical leader in the organization in terms of clinical mentorship, capacity to train new providers, and being the champion for PLH policy and procedures. A person in this position would exemplify a commitment to the PLH mission and values, an understanding of the importance of championing new and established policies and procedures working closely with the Medical Lead team and Medical Directors to support new policies. The position requires a willingness to be collaborative, positive, and solutions-based as a team member for PLH providers. The lead position includes being part of the PLH clinical pool which requires the provider to be accessible to fellow providers to discuss and process clinical issues that can arise through the day. The lead position can include leading PLH’s success in our MOD program to collaborate with partnerships to ensure the program is running smoothly and patients are being seen within the MOD hours at an appropriate rate. Also making sure the glossary is up to date.

Responsibilities:

  • Meets all the above PLH medical provider expectations
  • Clinical expert resource to other PLH medical providers in the area of provider policies
  • Acts as a lead virtual trainer and clinical support resource for new PLH medical providers, including clinical onboarding, orientation, workflow education, documentation expectations, and ongoing development support.
  • Provider/chart reviews when needed- will co-sign responsibilities as needed
  • Mentors, promotes, and fully supports adherence to PLH Clinical and Administrative Policies
  • Assists with outreach and standardization of the PLH MOD platform. Provides ongoing support to administration staff and providers
  • Promotes adherence to FRC Clinical and Administrative Policies
  • Reviews clinical quality trends and assists in identifying opportunities for improvement on workflows.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by PLH Clinical Leadership.

Qualifications:

Must be a virtual provider with experience caring for MOD patients.

  • Must have a minimum of two (2) years of provider experience.
  • Must consistently meet Medical Lead productivity and performance expectations.
  • Demonstrated excellence in clinical documentation, compliance standards, and quality patient care.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and support fellow providers.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the PLH mission, values, patient-centered care, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to identify challenges, recommend solutions, and support implementation of organizational initiatives.

Job Breakdown:

The Medical Lead is a full-time (40-hour per week), exempt salary position
that includes maintaining clinical provider responsibilities while dedicating designated administrative time to leadership responsibilities.

Administrative responsibilities may include provider mentorship, onboarding support, chart reviews, MOD program support, workflow standardization, and policy implementation.

Clinical hours will be scheduled based on organizational needs. Administrative time will be a minimum of two (2) hours per month or additional time as approved by the Medical Directors and Executive Team based on clinical business needs.

The Medical Lead provides clinical leadership and mentorship but does not assume the responsibilities of the Senior Medical Lead or Medical Director roles.

Salary: Internal Promotion, standard 1-3% increase of base salary

raw.description:
Staff Engineers at SmartLogic provide technical leadership for multiple ongoing projects and help develop solutions for prospects and clients. Work is organized by project, with each staffed by a Project Manager, a Staff Engineer, Designers, and Developers. The Staff Engineer owns the planning and implementation of technical delivery and team efficiency, and works with the Project Manager to maintain the Product Requirements Document, Backlog, technical direction, and sprint planning. They commit directly to the codebase, pair program, lead code review, and use AI tools to speed up delivery without compromising quality. While not a direct supervisor, the Staff Engineer acts as technical expert and mentor to the team, and also assists in the pre-sales process through solutioning, scope refinement, and estimates.

This is a contract engagement with an hourly rate of $90-$110 per hour, based on experience. This position has flexible weekly hours based on project needs and your availability, which is currently estimated at 25-40 per week. You must be available during SmartLogic's core working hours of 10:00 AM–3:30 PM ET on weekdays, as some client and internal meetings occur during this window and your attendance may be required.

This position is fully remote within the United States and its Territories. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own taxes, benefits, and insurance; SmartLogic does not provide employee benefits for this engagement.

Responsibilities

  • Support teams of 2 to 6 developers, designers, and QA analysts of varying skill levels and experience, providing guidance to ensure delivery on project commitments and meet client expectations.
  • Co-lead delivery projects in partnership with the Project Manager to deliver projects on budget and on time.
  • Mentor team members on assigned projects to follow SmartLogic processes for product development, including effective and responsible use of AI-assisted tools, working with the Project Manager to plan weekly goals to keep projects on track.
  • Provide hands-on leadership for CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, AI innovations, environment configuration, and production operations.
  • Work closely with the COO, Operations Manager, Project Managers, and team to communicate project progress, challenges, and resourcing needs.
  • Partner with sales and consulting leadership on technical discovery, solution architecture, and rough-order-of-magnitude estimates that are timely and defensible, bringing consistency to how the team approaches quoting and estimating.
  • Design, review, and support scalable, secure cloud and server architectures (primarily AWS and Azure).
  • Serve as the technical expert on assigned projects, including QA and PR review, with attention to the quality and security of AI-assisted code.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience with modern software development practices and technologies, creating custom software to meet the expectations of a variety of clients.
  • 7+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails, Elixir, and Phoenix, and 2+ years with Flutter and/or React Native.
  • 5+ years of experience with DevOps practices including CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, deployment, and tooling (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, cloud monitoring).
  • Practical, hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools in a real production codebase (not limited to prototyping or personal projects) for code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, or documentation, with the discipline to validate AI-generated code against normal testing and review standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate AI tools and practices and establish repeatable workflows for a team, with the judgment to recognize when AI assistance helps versus when it introduces security, privacy, or quality risk.
  • 3+ years in a consultancy, not solely product-based companies.
  • Experience participating in technical discovery, solution design, and estimation for client-facing and sales prospect projects.
  • Be organized, thoughtful, and intentional about process, as demonstrated by an ability to set and manage expectations among teammates and managers alike.

SmartLogic is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.

No phone calls or unsolicited emails, please. We do not work with recruiters or placement agencies.

About SmartLogic

SmartLogic is an experienced and growing custom software development consultancy successfully serving clients since 2005. We are deeply committed to our team, our clients, and the communities where we work. Some of our recent company initiatives include leading on youth workforce development, software developer apprenticeships, our Elixir Wizards podcast, and the Baltimore Women in Tech micro-grants program. SmartLogic values both continuous growth and giving back to the community, so there may be opportunities to engage at the professional level through conferences and our podcast.

The CSM’s overall responsibility is to build, maintain and grow our customer relationships by being their website performance specialist. The CSM II will use their OEM, product, and industry knowledge to address proactive and reactive customer requests and issues.   • Prioritize, triage, and communicate resolution on escalated customer issues and requests
  • Manage multiple accounts simultaneously, tracking the status of each project, and updating all stakeholders
  • Assist business leads in driving customer retention and identifying business growth opportunities

Overview

Leads clinical recruiting for MRO's Curation Solutions business, overseeing the attraction, engagement, and hiring of credentialed healthcare professionals across multiple registry service lines. This role is responsible for developing clinical talent pipelines, executing cohort hiring strategies, and leading a team focused on meeting clinical workforce demands. This is a working leadership role. The Senior Manager carries an active requisition load, leading full-cycle recruitment for leadership, specialized, and business-critical clinical positions while providing day-to-day leadership, coaching, and development to the recruiting team. This role partners closely with Clinical Operations leaders and Talent Acquisition leadership to drive hiring results and ensure a consistent, high-quality recruiting approach across the business

Responsibilities

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Lead clinical recruiting efforts across Curation Solutions service lines.
  • Develop and execute recruiting strategies for credentialed healthcare professionals.
  • Develop talent pipelines for specialized registry and abstraction professionals supporting hospital quality, accreditation, and regulatory reporting programs.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations leaders to forecast hiring needs and workforce plans.
  • Manage cohort-based hiring programs aligned with onboarding and training schedules.
  • Personally recruit for leadership, specialized, and hard-to-fill clinical positions.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of recruiters while driving performance and accountability.
  • Monitor recruiting metrics including time-to-fill, pipeline health, and offer acceptance rates.
  • Develop sourcing strategies and external partnerships to strengthen clinical talent pipelines.
  • Support recruiting operations, process improvements, ATS optimization, candidate experience initiatives, and onboarding coordination.

Qualifications

SKILLS | EXPERIENCE:
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of recruiting experience, including significant experience recruiting healthcare or clinical talent.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare credentialing and clinical talent markets.
  • Experience recruiting clinical, coding, nursing, or other credentialed healthcare professionals preferred.
  • Experience supporting high-volume hiring environments required
  • Demonstrated player-coach leadership style with the ability to manage requisitions while leading a team.
  • Experience improving recruiting processes and driving operational excellence.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (iCIMS preferred), sourcing tools, and recruiting analytics.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.

Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also receive an annual cash bonus and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Salary Range It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. Individual pay may be influenced by factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

PayIt is a fast-growing GovTech company on a mission to modernize how residents interact and transact with government, improving the customer experience and helping our client agencies more efficiently and effectively achieve their missions. Our easy-to-implement platform consolidates government services and payments into one connected experience and enables our clients to drive resident trust, collect revenue quickly, and redeploy their staff to more important challenges. This innovative approach to government service delivery has garnered significant recognition in both the public and private sectors, including our inclusion in the GovTech 100 every year since 2017. PayIt solutions cover services including hunting and fishing licensing, DMV, courts, property tax, utilities, tolling, and more.

Our culture welcomes people who exhibit what we call “PayIt DNA”: High integrity, drive, grit, high aptitude, and team orientation. We are collaborative and passionate about the work we do to improve the lives of our government clients and the end users they serve. We have ambitious scaling goals, and we look for team members who are ready to roll up their sleeves, solve problems, and find new opportunities to win with our clients. And we have a lot of fun together.

Release Planning and Coordination:

  • Develop and maintain PayIt Outdoors Release schedule by coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of business goals and project objectives and deliverables.
    • Working with the client teams and engineering teams to plan and deploy hotfixes.
    • Working with the DBE’s and Eng teams to schedule and deploy releases.
  • Collaborate with product managers, operations, development teams, and quality assurance to define release scope and objectives.

Release Execution

  • Oversee the end-to-end release process, including User Acceptance and Production deployment activities and rollback plans, to ensure smooth and successful releases.
    • Schedule and run release reviews
    • Make sure required work is included in releases.
    • Keep track of the branches and make sure the merges occur after sprints.

Communication and Documentation:

  • Communicate release schedules, status updates, and potential risks to stakeholders.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of release processes, configurations, and dependencies.
  • Create and maintain documentation of issues and resolutions.

Risk Management:

  • Identify and mitigate potential risks that may impact the success of software releases.
  • Establish and enforce change control and release management processes.

Incident management

  • Oversee the end-to-end PayIt Outdoors incident response lifecycle. Key responsibilities include coordinating cross-functional resources during active incidents, validating proper resolution and closure, and tracking critical process metrics to continuously improve response efficiency.

Jira Administration

  • Workflow Architecture: Design, build, and maintain custom Jira workflows, issue types, field configurations, and permission schemes tailored to team needs.
  • Process Automation: Create and optimize Jira Automation rules and integrations to streamline operational handoffs and reduce manual overhead.
  • Project & User Administration: Manage site-level project configurations, access control, user roles, and board configurations across departments.
Annual Salary Range:
$110,000—$140,000 USD

Why Work For Us:

  • Our mission matters. Your work will make life better for our government agency clients and the millions of residents they serve.
  • You’ll do some of the best work of your career here. We tackle complex challenges that are interesting to solve, and you’ll grow a ton working at PayIt
  • People are our most important resource. Everyone has a voice. Collaboration is our default setting. And we have fun together.
  • We #payitforward with our corporate volunteer program, serving the communities where we work and live.
  • Competitive salaries, excellent benefits, flexible working arrangements, and all the resources you will need to do your best work.

What We Care About:

We hire high-aptitude, high-integrity people who are great communicators and want to be part of a growing team.

A Note About AI at PayItWe love AI. We use it every day and encourage our team to find creative, effective ways to put it to work. If you join PayIt, you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. During the interview process, though, we want to hear from you, not a model. Our goal is to understand how you actually think, solve problems, and communicate, so we ask that your live conversations and assessment responses be your own work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who is American College of Education
Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

Who You Are
You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

As an Adjunct Faculty for American College of Education, you maintain a strong academic presence and growth in professional development for teaching, scholarly or creative works, and service to the profession and to the college. You report and work directly under the leadership of the department chair who provides guidance regarding 1) academic and teaching responsibilities, 2) service to students, department, college, and community, and 3) professional development.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. Adjuncts are paid per student per course here at ACE, and in general the pay is $50/student at the bachelor and master levels, and $126/student at the doctorate level. There are also opportunities to serve on paid committees, as well as receive payment for writing and developing courses.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by the organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, and adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel
  • Must support and embrace the College's Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day to Day Responsibilities
In this role, you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

Academic and Teaching Responsibilities

An adjunct faculty relates directly to students, handling instructional responsibilities to support, strengthen, and enhance the learning experience.

  • Interacts directly with students in an appropriate, professional manner.
  • Facilitates a safe and productive learning environment for students.
  • Responds in a timely manner to student requests for information, clarification of content, posts, and personal queries, and contacts inactive students as the need arises.
  • Oversees the quality of the course by reviewing the functionality and content, ensuring high-quality delivery of content.
  • Expands the student experience by “fingerprinting” the course content with unique personal experience, insights, or other professional knowledge.
  • Monitors and provides appropriate student feedback on assignments within college policies.
  • Synthesize and reports student performance data in a timeline manner.

Service to Students, Department, College and Community.

Faculty understand and support professional relationships within the course room, department, institution and beyond.

  • Supports the policies procedures and guidelines of the program and institution.
  • Aid student learning of ethical conduct, particularly related to plagiarism and copyright infringement; follows appropriate procedures in reporting infractions.
  • Directs students to supplemental resources as needed to enhance their individual skills and abilities.
  • Works collaboratively with colleagues and leadership of the college including attending required meetings.
  • Promotes the vision, mission, and culture of the college within and beyond the institution.
  • Provides appropriate leadership within one’s individual sphere of influence.

Professional Development.

As a demonstration of lifelong learning, faculty pursue endeavors to augment personal and professional skills.

  • Maintains a professional and technical knowledge of the curricula and industry by participating in leading-edge educational workshops/seminars, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies. This includes maintaining a deep knowledge of emerging issues and trends related to the department.
  • Ensures the quality of program and course offerings by supporting and promoting research.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Earned a terminal degree and experience in Leadership, Higher Education, Research or Community College.
  • 1+ year experience in teaching and leadership in a formal educational setting using both traditional and non-traditional teaching formats, higher education strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in successfully developing online/virtual professional relationships.
  • Evidence of professional research and/or creative endeavors and expertise in the field.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6 consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition, being named a USA Top Workplace in 2022, 2023 and 2024. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a family-like inclusive work environment.

Physical Demands
The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real-time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Employees are increasingly integrating AI into their roles, demonstrating its potential to boost efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. This position will join the Advizex team, a Myriad360 company.

About Advizex

Advizex, a Myriad360 company, brings together over 50 years of innovation and client commitment. As part of Myriad360’s growing portfolio, Advizex continues to operate with the same trusted expertise and customer-first philosophy—now strengthened by broader resources and reach.

For over 50 years, Advizex has done more than simply keep pace with technology—it has helped organizations stay ahead of it. With deep, real-world experience across healthcare, education, government, manufacturing, and retail, Advizex delivers IT solutions that solve meaningful business challenges across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

This role will join the Advizex team and play a key part in continuing that legacy.

Learn more about Advizex here!

ROLE OVERVIEW

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing Managed Services Provider. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Level 5 Storage & Backup Enterprise Services Architect to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will possess in-depth knowledge of storage and backup systems and demonstrate strong leadership and problem-solving skills. This is a senior-level position that requires extensive experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining complex storage and backup environments.

This position is supported by a 24x7x365 team, but occasional evening and weekend work may be required to handle emergencies or perform system maintenance.

Candidates must be based in the United States.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture & Managed Services Leadership
    • Define and own customer-facing hybrid cloud architectures for Azure-based managed services.
    • Design, standardize, and evolve multi-tenant managed service platforms supporting multiple enterprise customers.
    • Ensure architectures align with contractual SLAs, SLOs, and support models.
    • Establish and enforce architecture, security, and operational standards across customer environments.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership
    • Maintain hands-on involvement with storage and backup systems in production.
    • Lead troubleshooting and serve as the highest-level escalation point for complex customer issues.
    • Architect resilient platforms with strong monitoring, alerting, backup, and disaster recovery.
  • Customer Engagement & Advisory
    • Act as a technical lead and trusted advisor for enterprise customers.
    • Participate in customer architecture reviews, technical workshops, and QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews).
    • Translate customer business requirements into secure, supportable cloud architectures.
    • Support presales and solution design, including architecture validation, scoping, and risk assessment.
    • Guide customers through cloud adoption, modernization, and hybrid integration strategies.
  • Operations & Reliability
    • Provide architectural leadership for 24×7 managed service operations, including on-call participation.
    • Lead major incident response efforts, including customer communication and post-incident reviews.
    • Drive reliability, performance, and cost optimization improvements across customer platforms.
    • Ensure operational readiness for new customers and onboardings.
  • Mentorship & Influence
    • Mentor senior engineers and architects within the MSP organization.
    • Influence technical strategy, tooling, and service offerings across the managed services portfolio.
    • Evaluate Azure services and technologies to improve customer outcomes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience:
    • 15+ years of experience in storage and backup system administration and engineering in enterprise environments.
    • 5+ years designing and operating Microsoft Azure for enterprise or MSP customers.
    • Deep, hands-on storage and backup system administration experience in enterprise production environments.
    • Proven experience managing Dell storage and backup solutions.
    • Deep expertise in the administration of storage and backup systems.
    • Experience with backup and recovery processes.
  • Certifications:
    • Required: One Dell backup/data-protection certification, such as Dell Avamar, Data Domain, or PowerProtect; and
    • One specialized Dell enterprise storage certification in either:
      • Dell PowerScale(formerly Isilon); or
      • Dell PowerMax(formerly VMAX).
    • Azure Architect Certification (nice to have).
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated leadership abilities, including project management and team mentoring.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and technologies.

Preferred:

  • 15+ years of prior Storage and Backup administration experience in complex corporate or enterprise environments.
  • Extensive experience delivering customer-facing managed services in SLA-driven environments.
  • Strong expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, enterprise networking, identity, and security.
  • Strong expertise in Cisco products.
  • Extensive background in 24×7 cloud and infrastructure operations, including incident response.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration at scale (Docker, Kubernetes / AKS).
  • Additional Azure certifications (Azure Security Engineer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert).
  • Experience working in MSPs or consulting organizations supporting multiple enterprise customers.
  • Familiarity with ITIL, SRE, or service management frameworks.
  • Experience supporting regulated, high-availability, or compliance-driven environments.
  • Exposure to cloud migration and modernization engagements.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're looking for a Business Analyst to turn business problems into clear, buildable requirements. You'll sit between our clients, our product team, and our engineers: running discovery, mapping processes, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and making sure what we ship actually solves the problem it was meant to solve.
You'll work across a mix of client builds, client maintenance engagements, and Bluelight's internal products, and you'll play a key role when new projects are being scoped and estimated.

Responsibilities

  • Lead stakeholder interviews and workshops with clients and internal teams to understand goals, current workflows, and pain points.
  • Document current-state and future-state processes, business rules, data definitions, and edge cases.
  • Support new-project sizing by breaking scope into epics and stories that engineering can estimate with confidence.
  • Identify assumptions, risks, dependencies, and open questions early, and drive them to resolution.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria in Jira.
  • Partner with the Product Manager to prioritize and groom the backlog ahead of each two-week sprint.
  • Work with UI/UX design in Figma to make sure flows and screens match the requirements, and flag gaps before development starts.
  • Answer engineering questions during the sprint and keep requirements current as decisions are made.
  • Work with QA to make sure acceptance criteria translate into solid test coverage.
  • Support sprint demos and coordinate user acceptance testing with clients.
  • Keep requirements documentation organized in Google Drive so decisions and their rationale are easy to find later.
  • Make sure compliance, security, and audit requirements (including SOC 2 considerations) are captured as explicit requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for clients on scope and requirements questions.
  • Translate between business and technical audiences clearly and without jargon in either direction.
  • Surface scope changes early and help the team and client understand the tradeoffs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role on software projects.
  • Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria in an agile/Scrum environment.
  • Proven ability to run discovery sessions and turn ambiguous input into structured requirements.
  • Comfort with process mapping and data modeling at a business level (flows, entities, relationships, rules).
  • Hands-on experience with Jira; familiarity with Figma and collaborative docs.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; comfortable leading client meetings with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Enough technical literacy to have productive conversations with engineers about APIs, integrations, databases, and system constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in an agency, consultancy, or software services environment juggling multiple clients.
  • Exposure to regulated or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., SOC 2, telecom/outbound compliance, education, fintech).
  • Experience writing requirements for integrations with third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with web application stacks (e.g., Laravel, React) and AWS.
  • Experience supporting estimation or proposal work for new projects.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

About Cozey

At Cozey, we’re all about empowering possibilities in your home and making furniture shopping as easy and enjoyable as possible. Our thoughtfully designed, stylish furnishings adapt to evolving lifestyles, combining innovation with a commitment to great value and customer service. As a fast-growing, online-first brand, our success is driven by a team that shares our passion for redefining the furniture experience.

Why Engineering at Cozey

At Cozey Engineering, we’re not just building software, we're building the backbone of a modern, efficient, and customer-obsessed e-commerce operation. From order to delivery, every step is powered by in-house systems that drive speed, accuracy, and seamless customer experiences. Our team owns everything from operational infrastructure and warehouse management systems to backend services that power our website and logistics.

The mission of the Senior Software Engineer at Cozey

As Senior Software Engineer reporting to Manager, Software Engineering (WMS), your mission is to design and build the systems that power the post purchase journey of the product creating a seamless client experience. You’ll create scalable, in-house solutions that replace third-party tools, ensuring speed, accuracy, and innovation at every step. By owning projects from idea to deployment, you’ll help redefine how customers receive furniture with ease.

What you'll be doing

  • Build new features for our flagship product — the Cozey Operating System (COS)
  • Create in-house tools and platforms to replace third-party solutions — we love building things from the ground up.
  • Develop AI agents to automate and streamline warehouse management workflows
  • Collaborate closely with operations and product teams to identify pain points and rapidly launch impactful solutions
  • Own projects end-to-end — from design and architecture to implementation and deployment

We'd love to hear from you if you have

  • Extensive experience in strongly typed, object-oriented or TypeScript-like languages
  • Experience designing, building, and evolving robust REST APIs
  • Strong believer in testing culture – prioritizes unit and end-to-end testing
  • Deep appreciation for clean code, code reviews, and documentation
  • Passionate about solving real-world problems with scalable, maintainable solutions
  • Experience with AWS (Serverless, SQS, SNS etc) is a nice to have

We care about you

  • You will receive a competitive salary along with a comprehensive benefit package.
  • Endless opportunities for personal and professional growth in a fast-growing start-up.
  • A generous PTO policy that allows you the time you need to recharge.
  • A role where your strategies and decisions directly influence the company’s operations and growth.

Please note that we may use AI-powered tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as application screening and interview coordination. These tools help us focus our time where it matters most: getting to know candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people, and we’re committed to a fair and inclusive process.

  • Roadmap & governance: Own the program roadmap, controls, cadence, KPIs/OKRs, and standardized reporting/compliance.

  • Risk & performance: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate program-level risks, maintaining a centralized register and contingency plan; manage budget, ROI, and outcomes; deliver clear exec-ready updates.
  • Stakeholders & change: Tailor communications for execs and delivery teams; run change control; keep teams aligned and engaged.
  • Consistency & quality: Standardize and enforce processes/templates and ensure benefits realization with high delivery standards.
  • Process engineering & improvement: Track record of strategizing, developing and applying vigorous process engineering with daily continuous-improvement practices to lead complex programs from design through execution.
  • Adaptability and Problem-Solving: Track record of navigating unexpected challenges (e.g., scope changes, delays) with creative, structured solutions

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years program management experience, overseeing multi-stream projects with globally distributed teams, with size of over 50 team members and multiple project managers
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, management, or a related field; master's degree and relevant certifications (e.g., PMP) preferred.
  • Governance & structure: Build WBS/dependency maps, standardize processes, and maintain solid documents (e.g., charters, risk logs).
  • Tools & reporting: MS Project, Jira, SharePoint, Excel, and a PPM tool (e.g., Mavenlink/Kantata); build dashboards and status reports.
  • Strategy & outcomes: Align roadmaps to contract/business goals; drive benefits realization.
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated ability to align programs with the client contract goals, with examples of developing roadmaps or linking projects to strategic outcomes.
  • Risk & dependencies: Proactive RAID management, PMI-style risk frameworks, and contingencies.
  • Stakeholders & leadership: Exec-ready comms, RACI, conflict resolution, and high-EQ leadership across distributed teams.
  • Financial Acumen: Experience managing program budgets, tracking expenditures, and justifying cost adjustments to executives including management of projects with complex financial models involving (Fixed Price, T&M, Milestone based payments, Revenue Recognition, and Fixed Monthly fees, and Expense recovery).
  • Financials, resourcing & change: Own budgets and resource plans; lead change control; solve issues with rigor; strong attention to detail (IBM i modernization exposure a plus).
  • Organizational and Structured Skills: Proven ability to create structured plans (e.g., Work Breakdown Structures, dependency maps) and standardize processes across teams, with examples of maintaining consistent documentation (e.g., risk logs, program charters).
  • Knowledge (Preferred): Familiarity with application modernization or a demonstrated ability to quickly adapt to new sectors.

 

What you should have: 

  • PMP certification
  • Experience with hybrid Agile-Waterfall methodologies in large-scale programs.
  • Proficiency in creating governance frameworks, including steering committees or compliance processes.
  • Strong negotiation skills to resolve resource conflicts or stakeholder disputes.
  • Experience with C-Suite stakeholders

We are always looking for highly motivated, energetic, creative individuals who work well in a fast-moving team environment and are committed to excellence.
