Who We Are

Point32Health is a leading not-for-profit health and well-being organization dedicated to delivering high-quality, affordable healthcare. Serving nearly 2 million members, Point32Health builds on the legacy of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care and Tufts Health Plan to provide access to care and empower healthier lives for everyone. Our culture revolves around being a community of care and having shared values that guide our behaviors and decisions. We’ve had a long-standing commitment to inclusion and equal healthcare access and outcomes, regardless of background; it’s at the core of who we are. We value the rich mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all of our colleagues, which helps us to provide service with empathy and better understand and meet the needs of the communities where we serve, live, and work.

We enjoy the important work we do every day in service to our members, partners, colleagues and communities. Learn more about who we are at Point32Health.

Job Summary

The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN, is a licensed professional that is expected to function independently in his/her role and is responsible for managing clinically complex caseload of members for one or more lines of business for such as the inpatient settings; acute, subacute, acute rehabilitation, LTAC (Long-Term Acute Care). . The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN is responsible for making the determination of medical necessity and, therefore, benefit coverage for multiple products / lines of business, such as Commercial (FI, SI, and exchange products), state specific Medicaid programs, or Federal programs or in and out of area. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN is expected to demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN will be expected to demonstrate clinical judgement and health plan business knowledge in their decision-making processes, on behalf of the health plan. A working understanding of departmental workflows, policies, and procedures, and understanding of the corporate business goals and objectives. Accountability for outcome measures is critical to the Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN’s success in this role. Provides timely, clinically appropriate, and cost-effective utilization management and discharge planning activities for Point32Health members receiving services at her / his assigned facilities and may be required to float to provide coverage at unassigned facilities. Inpatient management functions include but are not limited to; application of clinically relevant criteria sets to determine medical necessity, level of care and/or readiness for transition to a lesser level of care setting. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN will develop effective working relationships with providers to facilitate the transition of the member through their continuum of care following department work processes and policies. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN will be expected to have direct experience with evidence based clinical criteria sets (such as InterQual or MNGs), Point32Health proprietary Medical Necessity Guidelines and product specific payment policies. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN may have responsibility for multiple types of service reimbursement models, depending upon the LOB (Line of Business) and/or assigned facilities contractual arrangements. Examples include but may not be limited to DRG, and/or per diem reimbursement models. The Clinical Reviewer, Inpatient RN works under the general direction of the Inpatient Manager of the team/s and the Director of the Department.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities/Duties – what you will be doing (top five):

  • Provide a range of utilization management (UM) activities for members in an inpatient setting.
  • Utilize industry standard / plan proprietary criteria for determining the appropriateness of the inpatient setting on an initial and concurrent review basis, both acute and post-acute (as noted above).
  • Determines reimbursement methodology and schedules concurrent review appropriately.
  • Reviews inpatient admissions, continued stays, t by fax or other electronic means for length of stay (LOS), medical necessity, discharge planning.
  • identifies and determines medical necessity for out of network requests.
  • Performs discharge planning for both acute and post-acute admissions.
  • Identifies complex members and refers members to case management or disease management programs based on member specific diagnoses, circumstances or psychosocial needs, and product / LOB program requirements.
  • s
  • Redirects members and providers to in network or in network preferred providers, including transition back to the Point32Health Plans service area.
  • Identifies potential High Risk High Needs members and presents at Consultive Rounds for inclusion of additional interventions.
  • May be required to conducts preauthorization of transplant requests.
  • Performs case documentation according to Department standards including but not limited to timely completion of daily tasks, timely management of assigned UM events and same day case data entry.
  • Mentor new and existing staff in process and system changes/updates
  • Facilitate UM/CM (Consultive Rounds.
  • Become subject matter expert (SME’s) to support the Inpatient Management Initiatives MedHOK, Case Trakker, Jiva,
  • Assist the Team Manager in day-to-day activities/assignments to the team as needed.
  • Develop effective and collaborative relationships with key customers:
  • ,
  • With partner departments in / across Point32Health to coordinate and expedite clinical and administrative processes as needed
  • Prepares cases for presentation at and actively participates in weekly UM/CM Consultive Rounds.
  • Participates in committees or as team liaison as needed.
  • Maintains professional growth and development through self-directed learning activities and/or involvement in professional, civic, and community organizations.
  • Performs additional related duties as assigned.

Qualifications – what you need to perform the job.

Certification and Licensure

  • Registered nurse with current, unrestricted Massachusetts RN license

Education

  • Required (minimum): Associate degree
  • Preferred: BSN (Bachelor of Science in Nursing)

Experience (minimum years required):

  • Required (minimum): 3 years of clinical nursing experience; 3 years of Utilization Management experience.

Skill Requirements

  • Strong people skills to form positive and collaborative relationships.
  • Effective communication skills
  • Strong t negotiation skills
  • Ability to multitask and utilize clinical judgment to identify issues and escalate accordingly to a Manager.
  • Ability to apply Evidence Based Criteria and/or P32H Medical Necessity Guidelines to support utilization management.
  • Ability to mentor
  • Ability to assume additional responsibilities such as special projects, while managing a case load, flexibility
  • Ability to use a laptop to accurately document utilization management activities adhering to department documentation standards.

Ubiminds is a GPTW-certified company. As an organization partnering with U.S. software companies, our core value is people first. Ubi custom-selects the top 5% of Brazilian talent to support our clients' LATAM growth strategies.

ABOUT THE ROLE

A Client Partner owns a portfolio of accounts from the day the first contract is signed. You are the person a client's VP of Engineering calls when they need three more engineers by Q3. You are also the person who notices, before the client does, when one of our squads is drifting off the outcome we promised. You own the relationship, the renewal, the expansion, and the number.

This is not an inbox-farming account manager role. You will carry a retention and growth target, sit across the table from client executives, and lead the shift from staff augmentation toward consulting engagements built around outcomes. If you like owning a relationship the size of a small P&L, and you can talk roadmap with a CTO one hour and margin with our CFO the next, keep reading.

Responsibilities & Core Duties

  • A portfolio of U.S. client accounts: their health, their satisfaction, their renewals, and their revenue.

  • Net revenue retention and expansion. You grow accounts by adding engineers and squads, and by attaching Furiosa work such as AI Delivery Pods, the AI Acceleration program, and advisory and governance engagements.

  • The account operating rhythm: quarterly account plans, QBRs and executive business reviews, monthly cadence on Tier 1 Strategic accounts, and an account health score you keep honest.

  • Renewals and commercials: SOW and MSA extensions, pricing that stays above our margin floor, and a forecast leadership can trust.

  • The delivery partnership. You work alongside our delivery leads and LatAm talent org so the people we place are set up to hit the outcome. When a fit isn't right, you manage the change without drama.

  • Multi-threaded executive relationships. You build trust beyond a single champion, up to the C-suite, so an account doesn't wobble when one person leaves.

  • Voice of the customer. What you learn in accounts feeds our Furiosa offerings and go-to-market. You are the early-warning system and a source of new ideas.

REQUIREMENTS (WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE):

  • Seven or more years owning client relationships and a revenue number in staff augmentation, IT services, consulting, or enterprise SaaS, selling to and serving U.S. companies.

  • A real track record on retention and expansion: renewals closed, accounts grown, quotas carried and hit. Bring the numbers.

  • Fluency in how software actually gets built: agile teams, engineering staffing, distributed or nearshore delivery. You don't need to write code. You do need to hold a credible conversation with a VP of Engineering.

  • Command of the commercial mechanics: SOWs, MSAs, margin, and forecasting. You can price a deal and defend the margin.

  • Enough grounding in enterprise AI adoption to talk roadmap with a client executive and tell what's real from what's hype. We will deepen it; you bring the instinct.

  • Executive presence and consultative instincts. You listen first, you name the hard thing, and people trust you with the big decision.

  • Native-level English and comfort working in U.S. business culture.

NICE-TO-HAVES (WHAT WILL SET YOU APART):

  • You've worked inside a nearshore or offshore delivery model and know where it strains.

  • You've sold or delivered AI, ML, or data services.

  • Portuguese or Spanish.

  • You've built account management structure, not just worked within one. We are building this function now, and there is room to shape it.

raw.description:
At Raya, DevSecOps Engineers are passionate about building and maintaining robust, scalable infrastructure that empowers product engineering teams to innovate with confidence. You are excited to work with modern cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code technologies. The ideal candidate will have 6-8+ years of experience with demonstrated growth in previous roles, showing both technical depth and leadership in infrastructure engineering. You will join the Platform Engineering team to help evolve our infrastructure foundation during this period of rapid growth.
As a DevSecOps Engineer, you'll drive the technological advancement of our Infrastructure Platform within Raya. Leveraging best-in-class cloud technologies and container orchestration, your work will be central to delivering a reliable, secure, and scalable foundation that our product teams depend on daily. We prioritize learning and teamwork and love giving people the opportunity to champion infrastructure solutions to complex challenges while growing into the best versions of themselves.
A great candidate is excited to support our infrastructure initiatives across multi-regional environments, Kubernetes orchestration, deployment automation, and observability. With a strong focus on performance optimization, you can design infrastructure that maximizes application efficiency and resource utilization. You're enthusiastic about leveraging AI to enhance your own infrastructure workflows, automate complex tasks, and maximize the scale and impact of your work. You design infrastructure architecture in a scalable, evidence-based manner while understanding the value of working within established systems and thoughtfully introducing improvements. Finally, you believe in Raya's vision of enriching lives by fostering relationships through quality, in-person interactions.
We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity-based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity.

Responsibilties

  • Infrastructure Leadership: Design and build major new infrastructure components and platforms to support Raya's growing needs
  • Kubernetes & Container Orchestration: Lead our Kubernetes strategy, designing and implementing container orchestration solutions that optimize for various application workloads
  • Performance Optimization: Design and optimize infrastructure for maximum application performance, focusing on memory management, resource allocation, network traffic optimization, and system efficiency
  • Reliability Engineering: Implement SLOs, monitoring, and observability solutions to ensure high reliability of our platform
  • Cloud Engineering: Apply your in-depth knowledge of AWS to design scalable, resilient architectures across multiple regions
  • Incident Response: Participate in on-call rotations and lead complex infrastructure incident resolution and post-incident analysis
  • System Evolution: Thoughtfully improve existing infrastructure through incremental enhancements while respecting operational constraints
  • Deployment Automation: Enhance our CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies to enable faster, safer releases
  • AI-Enhanced Workflows: Integrate AI tools and capabilities into infrastructure workflows to automate complex tasks, enhance decision-making, and maximize operational efficiency
  • Infrastructure Security: Collaborate with security teams to implement secure-by-design infrastructure
  • Cost Optimization: Design cost-effective infrastructure solutions and implement optimization strategies
  • Team Mentorship: Contribute to engineering excellence by mentoring other infrastructure engineers

Qualifications

  • A BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Systems Administration, or a related technical field (Professional experience can be substituted for candidates with non-engineering educational backgrounds)
  • 6-8+ years of hands-on experience with infrastructure engineering, with a track record of designing and implementing scalable infrastructure solutions
  • Strong expertise in Kubernetes and Docker, with experience designing and managing production container orchestration environments
  • Demonstrated expertise in AWS and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Ansible)
  • Experience with performance tuning and optimization of both infrastructure and applications
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, Go, Ruby)
  • Experience working with and incrementally improving established infrastructure environments
  • Strong collaborative instincts, emphasizing open communication, transparency, and cross-team interaction

Desired Qualifications

  • Background in SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) practices
  • Experience using AI tools to enhance infrastructure workflows, automate tasks, and improve operational efficiency
  • Knowledge of database administration and optimization (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch)
  • Experience with multi-regional/global infrastructure deployment and operations
  • Track record of successfully modernizing legacy infrastructure components
  • Strong understanding of Node.js performance characteristics and experience optimizing infrastructure for Node.js workloads, including memory management, CPU utilization patterns, and scaling considerations
  • Proficiency in application profiling and performance analysis tools
  • Experience with network infrastructure and security
  • Experience with infrastructure security and compliance controls
  • Understanding of cost optimization strategies in cloud environments
  • Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd, Consul)
  • Experience with other cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) in addition to AWS
  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and implementation

What Set's You Apart

  • Reliability Focus: You have a passion for building systems that are resilient, self-healing, and maintainable
  • Performance Optimizer: You have a keen eye for identifying bottlenecks and optimizing system performance at all levels of the stack
  • Problem Solver: You excel at diagnosing complex infrastructure issues and implementing effective solutions
  • Application-Aware Infrastructure: You design infrastructure that maximizes application performance by understanding how applications actually behave in production, with particular expertise in Node.js workloads
  • Pragmatic Innovator: You can balance working within existing constraints while strategically introducing improvements where they'll have the most impact
  • Context Builder: You take time to understand existing systems and historical decisions before proposing changes, appreciating the journey that led to the current state
  • Infrastructure Vision: You think beyond immediate needs to design infrastructure that can scale and evolve with Raya's growth
  • Automation Mindset: You're driven to automate manual processes and eliminate operational toil
  • AI-Powered Efficiency: You're excited about leveraging AI to amplify your capabilities, automate complex workflows, and achieve greater scale and impact in your infrastructure work
  • Impact-driven: You prioritize infrastructure initiatives that maximize impact, aligning with Raya's overarching goals
  • Growth-oriented: You possess a perpetual learner's mindset, open to challenges, and always seeking opportunities to expand your technical horizons

raw.description:
Description

About Coralogix

Coralogix is a full-stack observability and security platform built for modern engineering teams that need real-time visibility at scale.

Our platform brings together logs, metrics, traces, security events, infrastructure, Kubernetes, applications, and user experience in one place. With a no-index architecture and in-stream analytics, Coralogix helps customers reduce cost, retain more data, and troubleshoot faster without compromising scale or performance.

We are looking for technical sellers who can help customers understand the value of a different approach and prove it in real-world environments.

﻿This is a fully remote position, but candidates must be located within the US Eastern Time Zone (EST/EDT).

Compensation: $220,000 to $250,000 OTE

The Role

We are hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our East-Coast pre-sales team, Focusing on Enterprise FedRal Cloud Infrastructure clients.

This is a senior, hands-on technical sales role. You will partner with Account Executives to run technical discovery, lead product evaluations, design solutions, and help customers validate Coralogix in their own environments.

During evaluations, you will be expected to do more than present the platform. You will act as the technical owner, helping customers deploy, configure, integrate, troubleshoot, and validate Coralogix across their environment. You need to be credible with engineers, confident with executives, and capable of moving between architecture, code, configuration, and business value.

This role is for someone who can earn trust in technical conversations and help drive deals to a strong technical close.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical strategy for sales opportunities in partnership with Account Executives.
  • Lead discovery across customer architecture, telemetry sources, operational pain, business drivers, and success criteria.
  • Design and deliver tailored demonstrations that connect Coralogix to real customer use cases.
  • Manage technical evaluations and POCs from scope through validation.
  • Support hands-on deployment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting during evaluations.
  • Work with customers across logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes, cloud environments, applications, and security use cases.
  • Explain Coralogix’s architecture, differentiation, and value clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify technical risks, remove blockers, and guide customers toward a successful technical decision.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to represent field feedback and improve how we win.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Security Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on technical ability across deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration work.
  • Solid understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, APM, dashboards, alerting, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Experience leading technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept processes.
  • Ability to speak credibly with engineers, DevOps, SRE, platform, and security teams.
  • Confidence engaging executives and translating technical value into business impact.
  • Practical experience with cloud-native environments, distributed systems, containers, and modern infrastructure.
  • Coding or scripting experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or similar.
  • Strong communication, ownership, follow-through, and commercial judgment.

Technical Experience

Relevant experience may include:

  • Kubernetes and containerized environments
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Prometheus
  • Docker
  • APM and distributed tracing
  • Log analytics and telemetry pipelines
  • SIEM or security monitoring
  • Infrastructure monitoring
  • RUM
  • Terraform, Helm, or deployment automation
  • CI/CD workflows
  • Application instrumentation and debugging

What Success Looks Like

The best Solutions Engineers at Coralogix are not just strong presenters. They are technical owners.

They can uncover pain, define success, build a validation plan, and prove value in the customer’s environment. They are hands-on enough to earn credibility with practitioners and commercially aware enough to help move opportunities forward.

They know when to go deep, when to simplify, when to challenge, and when to escalate.

Why Join Coralogix

Observability is changing fast. Data volumes are growing, budgets are under pressure, and teams are rethinking the platforms they rely on.

Coralogix gives customers a different path: real-time analytics, open standards, strong security and observability use cases, and an architecture designed for scale.

As a Solutions Engineer, you will play a central role in strategic evaluations, competitive opportunities, and the technical decisions that help customers choose Coralogix.

﻿Compensation and Benefits

The on-target earnings range for this role is $220,000 to $250,000. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, education, and work location.

Our total rewards package includes healthcare, dental, mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid sick time, and paid time off.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Cultural Fit

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH **

Location: Remote – Latin America Work Arrangement: Fully Remote Employment Type: Full-Time | Independent Contractor Compensation: $1,500–$2,600 USD/month Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing / eCommerce English Proficiency: Advanced Professional English Required (C1 or higher)

About the Company

Our client is a profitable, fast-growing U.S.-based digital marketing and eCommerce agency that helps consumer brands scale through performance media, creative strategy, advanced measurement, and AI-powered solutions.

The agency combines human expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver measurable business results, focusing on profitability, efficiency, and sustainable growth rather than vanity metrics.

With strategic partnerships across leading advertising and social commerce platforms, including Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap, and Pinterest, the company operates at the forefront of digital marketing innovation.

The team embraces an AI-first mindset, entrepreneurial thinking, operational excellence, and a culture of ownership, where individuals are encouraged to take initiative, make decisions, and contribute directly to business growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive and business-minded Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to work directly with the founders and leadership team of a fast-moving digital marketing agency.

This is not a traditional administrative or scheduling position. It is a hands-on role that combines executive support, operational management, vendor oversight, process improvement, and business development.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful professional who takes ownership of responsibilities, exercises independent judgment, anticipates business needs, and makes decisions with minimal supervision.

You will oversee executive priorities, manage vendor relationships, optimize operational systems, and develop processes that improve efficiency across the organization. You will also contribute directly to revenue-generating initiatives by supporting prospect research, outbound outreach, pipeline development, and marketing activities.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an operator, executes like an executive assistant, and brings the commercial mindset needed to help a growing business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Founder Support

  • Manage executive calendars, inboxes, meetings, and communications, independently handling routine scheduling and prioritization decisions.

  • Act as a trusted point of contact between leadership, internal teams, vendors, and clients.

  • Anticipate executive needs, prioritize competing demands, and ensure timely follow-through on commitments.

  • Prepare meeting agendas, executive briefings, status reports, and other materials, synthesizing information to support effective decision-making.

  • Coordinate founders' personal appointments, scheduling, and occasional personal administrative needs with professionalism and discretion.

Vendor Relationship Management

  • Take ownership of day-to-day vendor relationships, including communications, issue resolution, service quality, and performance expectations.

  • Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate routine pricing and contract terms, and approve purchases within established authority limits.

  • Monitor vendor performance against agreed service standards and recommend improvements or alternative providers when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance records.

  • Identify potential vendor-related risks and escalate significant contractual or financial matters to leadership.

Operational Systems & Technology

  • Own the administration, organization, and continuous improvement of the company's operational tools and technology platforms.

  • Evaluate new software and AI-powered solutions, recommend improvements, and manage implementation and onboarding.

  • Troubleshoot operational system issues and coordinate with vendors when additional technical support is required.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity through technology.

  • Ensure operational systems support business objectives and remain organized, efficient, and scalable.

Process Design & Operational Improvement

  • Analyze existing workflows, identify operational inefficiencies, and independently develop improved processes.

  • Create, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational playbooks, and training documentation.

  • Establish clear workflows, quality control checkpoints, and accountability standards.

  • Identify operational risks and proactively implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reduce manual work, and support business growth.

Financial & Administrative Management

  • Monitor operational budgets, track expenditures, and flag potential variances.

  • Manage routine procurement decisions for software, supplies, and services within approved spending limits.

  • Maintain organized financial and administrative records.

  • Support leadership with operational reporting, expense tracking, and administrative planning.

Business Development & Revenue Support

  • Proactively contribute to revenue-generating activities when operational priorities are under control.

  • Research and qualify prospective clients, develop targeted prospect lists, and identify potential business opportunities.

  • Support outbound prospecting through personalized email campaigns, LinkedIn outreach, follow-ups, and lead nurturing.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, and coordinate next steps with the business development team.

  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, pitch decks, case studies, and other business development materials.

  • Coordinate go-to-market initiatives, including sales meetings, webinars, industry events, and strategic partnerships.

  • Support the agency's own marketing initiatives, including newsletters, social media, and content coordination.

  • Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and accelerate the sales process.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in executive support, business operations, administrative management, or a similar role involving significant independent responsibility.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, or marketing, including prospecting, pipeline development, outbound outreach, or campaign support.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting senior executives or managing operational functions with minimal supervision.

  • Proven ability to independently manage vendor relationships, including negotiations, performance monitoring, and contract coordination.

  • Experience designing, documenting, implementing, and improving operational processes.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Sound business judgment, with the ability to make independent decisions and recognize when leadership involvement is necessary.

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and experience administering business software and operational platforms.

  • Practical experience using AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve research, communication, sales, and operational efficiency.

  • A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the ability to identify opportunities to contribute to business growth.

  • Ability to work independently and maintain accountability in a fully remote environment.

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote workspace.

  • Full availability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Preferred

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency, performance marketing company, eCommerce business, or B2B services environment.

  • Experience supporting founders, CEOs, or other C-suite executives with delegated decision-making responsibilities.

  • Hands-on experience with CRM and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Asana, Monday.com, or Notion.

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, Google Ads, or social commerce operations.

  • Experience creating SOPs, operational playbooks, and process documentation from scratch.

  • Experience with sales prospecting tools, marketing automation, or AI-powered workflow automation.

  • Background in business development, lead generation, or outbound sales for agencies or professional services companies.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership can confidently delegate operational responsibilities, knowing that priorities are managed and commitments are consistently fulfilled.

  • Executive calendars, communications, and administrative responsibilities run smoothly with minimal supervision.

  • Vendor relationships are professionally managed, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.

  • Operational systems and workflows become increasingly efficient through automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • The business development team receives meaningful support through prospect research, outreach, pipeline management, and sales preparation.

  • You consistently identify opportunities to solve problems, improve processes, and contribute to the company's growth without waiting for instructions.

Who We're Looking For

You are an organized, resourceful, and entrepreneurial professional who enjoys operating at the intersection of executive support, business operations, and growth.

You are comfortable working directly with founders, taking responsibility for important business functions, and making thoughtful decisions independently.

You don't simply complete assigned tasks. You anticipate what needs to happen next, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action.

Most importantly, you understand that supporting leadership means creating capacity for the business to grow, whether through operational efficiency, better systems, stronger vendor relationships, or direct contributions to revenue-generating activities.

Work Arrangement & Compensation

  • Location: Remote – Latin America

  • Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

  • Monthly Compensation: $1,500–$2,600 USD, depending on experience and qualifications

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 8:30 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

This is a remote/telecommute position.

At ALTOUR, you’ll be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your voice matters and your success is a shared journey. Click here for more information about Altour.

Responsibilities

Altour has an exciting opportunity for a Sourcing Manager with event experience to work with a top client! The ideal candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing of hotels and venues, including contract negotiations and tracking of cost savings to client with a focus on client strategic business objectives and financial constraints (among other requirements). This role will collaborate with the designated Meeting Planner for the program to ensure smooth delivery and hand-off sourced venues for execution. This person will execute venue sourcing efforts for low to medium complexity meetings and events for client in a manner that promotes achievement of client business objectives. This role has strategic importance and high accountability as, by driving the venue selection process, it lays the foundation for client satisfaction, overall meeting / event quality, and Altour financial performance. A successful individual in this role will demonstrate both excellence in execution and high-quality strategic mindset centered on client business objectives. The ideal candidate must have experience building and distributing RFPs via the CVent supplier network.

Lead execution of venue sourcing efforts for low to medium complexity client meetings and events with a focus on client satisfaction and achievement of client strategic business objectives

indie.io is a US-based game management and publishing platform supporting independent developers from development through distribution - and beyond! Our mission is to provide independent developers with the resources, services, and management tools needed for success. Through collaboration and passion, we strive to cultivate a diverse and vibrant gaming landscape that resonates with players and creators alike!

About Indie.io

indie.io is a US-based game management and publishing platform supporting independent developers from development through distribution - and beyond! Our mission is to provide independent developers with the resources, services, and management tools needed for success. Through collaboration and passion, we strive to cultivate a diverse and vibrant gaming landscape that resonates with players and creators alike!

About the Role

We're looking for a contract Social Media Manager to own and grow indie.io's brand presence while also supporting the discoverability, momentum, and long-term growth of the games in our catalog. This is a 3-month contract position with the potential to convert to a full-time hire based on performance and business needs. This role blends traditional social media management with light community management responsibilities. This is a fully remote contract for U.S.-based candidates.

You'll be responsible for shaping how our publisher brand shows up online, amplifying our games in ways that feel native to each platform, and building genuine relationships with players, developers, and creators. This is a role for someone who is comfortable working autonomously, juggling multiple game titles at different stages, and making smart judgment calls without needing heavy oversight.

What You'll Do
Social & Brand Strategy
  • Own and execute indie.io's social media strategy across platforms such as X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Discord, and emerging channels as relevant.
  • Develop a cohesive brand voice that balances our publisher identity with the unique tone of individual games.
  • Plan and maintain a rolling social content calendar across a large, active catalog.
  • Track performance metrics (reach, engagement, growth, click-throughs) across platforms.
  • Use data to iterate on content formats, posting cadence, and platform focus.
Game & Catalog Promotion
  • Promote multiple games concurrently across different lifecycle stages (announcement, launch, updates, discounts, long-tail support).
  • Work closely with Marketing Managers and our in-house Creative teams to align messaging, beats, content production, and timing.
  • Identify scalable ways to spotlight games across multiple beats, including sales, physical and digital events, RDA and launch messaging, and more.
  • Maintain relationships with indie.io developers, cross-promoting their content and providing guidance on content strategies.
Community & Engagement
  • Engage with players, developers, and fans in comments, replies, DMs, and community spaces.
  • Act as a light-touch community manager: surfacing feedback, flagging sentiment shifts, and escalating issues when needed.
  • Help set expectations and best practices for developer-facing social and community interactions.
Content & Trends
  • Ideate, write, and publish platform-native content (including short-form video concepts, memes, threads, and reactive posts).
  • Stay current on gaming, internet, and platform trends.
  • Collaborate with internal designers, editors, and video teams to scale content production efficiently.
Who You Are
  • 3–4 years of experience in social media and/or community management, ideally in games, entertainment, or digital-native brands.
  • Strong understanding of, and passion for, gaming culture, indie games, and player communities.
  • Proven experience managing multiple brands, products, or content streams at once.
  • Excellent written communication skills and sharp content judgment.
  • Comfort working independently and making decisions in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with marketing, creative, and product teams.
  • Experience utilizing social media management & intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with Discord moderation and community tools is a plus.
  • Experience coordinating with content creators or influencer teams is not required, but a plus.
Compensation
  • $55,000 – $70,000 USD annualized rate (paid over the 3-month contract period, with adjustment to full-time salary upon conversion)

raw.title: Product Manager – Student Acquisition
raw.excerpt: Who is American College of Education Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs.
raw.description:
Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

The Product Manager, Student Acquisition owns the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the end-to-end student acquisition journey/value stream from prospective student through started student. This role serves as the strategic bridge among Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, and IT, translating institutional growth goals and student needs into a prioritized, outcome-based product roadmap. The Product Manager aligns people, processes, data, and technology across the student acquisition technology ecosystem. Success is measured through improved funnel conversion, faster decision-making and delivery, stronger operational efficiency, better prospective student experience, and clear accountability for the value delivered by technology investments.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $145,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.

Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success measures for the Student Acquisition value stream, aligned with institutional enrollment, revenue, and student experience goals.
  • Own the end-to-end prospect-to-started-student journey; use research, journey mapping, funnel data, and stakeholder feedback to identify friction, unmet needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Establish and monitor product objectives and key performance indicators, including speed-to-lead, stage conversion, application completion, yield, cycle time, adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Prioritize initiatives across the product ecosystem based on expected business value, student impact, risk, cost, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment; make transparent trade-off recommendations.
  • Translate business problems and desired outcomes into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and decision context for Product Owners, delivery teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
  • Partner with Product Owners and technology teams to sequence delivery, manage cross-platform dependencies, validate releases, and confirm that delivered capabilities achieve intended outcomes.
  • Guide product discovery, experimentation, usability testing, and continuous optimization; apply quantitative and qualitative evidence to product decisions.
  • Ensure consistent funnel definitions, lead qualification rules, attribution, consent, and data flow across channels and platforms in partnership with data and business owners.
  • Own the integrated product roadmap across CRM, marketing automation, digital experience, inquiry and application, communications, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
  • Evaluate platform capabilities, vendors, and investment options; develop business cases and recommendations that address value, total cost, scalability, reliability, integration, and technical debt.
  • Align Marketing, Enrollment, Admissions, Student Services, IT, and executive stakeholders around priorities, decisions, risks, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with operational leaders on process design, service levels, adoption, training, change management, and readiness for peak enrollment cycles.
  • Ensure product decisions support FERPA, privacy, consent, accessibility, security, data governance, responsible AI, and other applicable institutional requirements.
  • Communicate roadmap progress, product performance, financial impact, risks, dependencies, and decisions to executive and operational audiences.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in business, technology, marketing, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in product management, digital product strategy, business technology, CRM, enrollment technology, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a product strategy and roadmap across multiple platforms, business functions, and stakeholder groups.
  • Experience using product discovery, customer research, journey mapping, experimentation, and data analysis to prioritize work and improve measurable outcomes.
  • Strong working knowledge of CRM and lead management, marketing automation, digital experience, workflow, integration, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
  • Proven ability to define meaningful product metrics, interpret funnel and operational data, build business cases, and evaluate value, cost, risk, and trade-offs.
  • Experience partnering with Product Owners and Agile delivery teams; ability to translate strategy and business problems into outcome-based requirements without prescribing technical solutions.
  • Executive-level communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive decisions across competing priorities.
  • Experience with vendor evaluation, contract or service performance, implementation partners, and third-party platform dependencies.
  • Knowledge of privacy, accessibility, security, data governance, and responsible AI considerations for digital products.
  • Experience in higher education, student recruitment, enrollment, admissions, or a regulated consumer journey is strongly preferred.
  • Product management certification is preferred but not required.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6 consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following benefits:

•Medical, dental, & vision Insurance

•HSA and FSA options

•Paid parental leave

•Paid volunteer time

  • Tuition reimbursement & reduction programs

•Generous PTO

•401k and employer match

•Full-service wellness and EAP program

  • Employee recognition and awards programs

•Employer paid life & AD&D insurance

•Short-term disability

•Employer paid long-term disability

•And more…

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning, inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered, valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Employees are increasingly integrating AI into their roles, demonstrating its potential to boost efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. By utilizing AI technologies, we can streamline processes, gain valuable insights from data, and automate routine tasks, which allows employees to concentrate on more strategic and creative aspects of their work. While AI is a beneficial tool in the workplace, if its use—such as ChatGPT, Grammarly, Copy.ai, etc.—accounts for more than 50% of any work assignments or job responsibilities, it will need to be reported to a direct leader.

Internet bandwidth speeds from an employee's remote work location must be a minimum of 50Mbps download speeds and 5Mbps upload speeds. You can test the speed of your connection by visiting speedtest.net Purchase, setup, installation, support, and ongoing maintenance of reliable internet service is the responsibility of the individual.

“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Sr. Manager, Compliance Operations

The Senior Manager, Compliance Operations plays a key role within Mineralys’ compliance program and is responsible for operationalizing and sustaining a high-integrity compliance program across the organization. This role partners closely with the commercial, medical, and corporate functions to embed a culture of ethical behavior and regulatory accountability. The ideal candidate brings both technical expertise and a collaborative, approachable mindset to enable sustained business success while upholding the highest standards of compliance. The position will report to Mineralys’ Vice President, Compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation and ongoing optimization of Mineralys’ aggregate spend and transparency reporting system and operational processes to ensure timely and accurate reporting in compliance with federal and state laws (e.g., Sunshine Act/Open Payments, state transfer of value)
    • Develop and maintain data governance protocols, reconciliation processes, and quality controls to ensure data integrity across all reported spend categories
    • Serve as main business owner and liaison to IT and vendor partners
    • Prepare and support submission of aggregate spend reports to relevant government agencies and internal leadership
  • Support external funding requests (e.g., corporate sponsorships, corporate memberships, independent medical education, and research grants)
    • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on external funding-related compliance requirements
    • Administer review and approval processes to ensure alignment with applicable regulations, company policies, and fair market value standards
  • Support Mineralys’ compliance sample accountability program in accordance with the Prescription Drug Marketing Act (PDMA) and applicable state regulations
    • Liaise with sample accountability vendor, field sales, and commercial operations to support sample request, distribution, storage, and reconciliation procedures
    • Coordinate periodic sample inventories, investigate discrepancies, and implement corrective actions as needed
    • Work with sample accountability vendor to maintain accurate sample accountability records and produce reports for internal review and regulatory submissions
  • Assist in the development, design, review, and delivery of healthcare compliance related policies, SOPs, and trainings, all consistent with current regulatory guidance and industry best practices (e.g., PhRMA Code, OIG guidance, aggregate spend, third-party funding, sampling, code of conduct)
  • Support the compliance function in identifying gaps and proactively developing necessary resources to address compliance risk areas
  • Provide practical, solutions-oriented guidance that enables compliant business activities
  • Support special projects and initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; relevant professional certification (CHC, CCEP) preferred
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in healthcare or pharmaceutical compliance, with at least 2 years in a role with direct responsibility for transparency/aggregate spend reporting
  • Demonstrated experience managing third-party funding processes (grants, sponsorships, memberships) within a pharmaceutical or life sciences organization
  • Hands-on experience with aggregate spend technology platforms (e.g., Veeva Vault, Concur, MedPro, Medispend, Porzio, or comparable systems)
  • Familiarity with PDMA sample accountability requirements strongly preferred
  • Experience administering compliance training programs and working within an LMS (e.g., Veeva Vault Training, Cornerstone, or similar

Core Competencies

  • Deep working knowledge of the Sunshine Act/Open Payments regulations, state transfer of value laws, and applicable OIG guidance
  • Strong understanding of the PhRMA Code
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, operational guidance for business stakeholders
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to present compliance information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and influence without direct authority
  • High degree of professional integrity, sound judgment, and a collaborative, solutions-focused mindse

Travel

  • This position requires up to 10% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $175,000 - $190,000

raw.description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

Job Title: Sr. AI Solutions Architect

Job Summary:As a Sr. AI Solutions Architect, you will lead the design, construction, and deployment of AI solutions that combine the power of graph databases and AI. You will act as a trusted advisor to our strategic customers, guiding them through complex data challenges and delivering transformative business value. You will have a great understanding of graph technologies, LLMs, and AI frameworks, and will be able to translate customer needs into production-ready AI applications grounded in real-world context using Neo4j Knowledge Graphs.

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Architecting:

  • You will engage with technical leaders, stakeholders, and strategic partners to shape and guide the successful implementation of Graph+GenAI solutions, serving as a trusted advisor and thought partner to decision-makers throughout complex, high-impact engagements.
  • You will design and advocate for robust, scalable solution architectures, leading the deployment of Graph+GenAI systems aligned with complex enterprise requirements and industry best practices driving architectural excellence and long-term value.
  • You will collaborate closely with customer leadership to deeply understand their strategic objectives, translating them into high-impact AI solutions that harness the synergy of graph databases and LLMs. This includes leading the discovery of requirements, assessing enterprise data ecosystems, and identifying innovative opportunities to apply graph-based AI at scale.
  • You will lead stakeholder engagement across all levels to steer project scope, align on priorities, mitigate risks, and ensure timely delivery—ensuring alignment between technical execution and business outcomes while maintaining a focus on measurable impact

Solution Engineering:

  • You will develop, test, and deploy production-ready AI applications that integrate graph databases with LLMs and orchestration frameworks. This involves writing production-level code, optimizing for performance and scalability, and ensuring seamless integration with customer systems.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve the performance, scalability, and efficiency of deployed AI applications, incorporating new techniques and technologies as they emerge.

Education & Enablement:

  • You will work with other teams at Neo4j (Product and Marketing) to influence the roadmap and provide insights from the field, and package approaches, best practices, and lessons learned into thought leadership, methodologies, and published assets.
  • You will share your expertise internally with other Neo4j teams and also with customers through workshops, training sessions, and documentation to empower them to effectively utilize, maintain, and reproduce the AI solutions you deliver.
  • Maintain continuous learning and stay up-to-date with the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape, proactively seeking knowledge of new trends and technologies.

Required Qualifications:

  • Enterprise Application Architecture: 7+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise-grade applications, with a deep understanding of the full software development lifecycle and the ability to guide teams through complex design and implementation decisions.
  • LLM Proficiency: 2+ years of Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and integrating LLMs into applications. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of different LLM providers and their strengths and limitations, as well as open-source ones).
  • Programming Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Java, JavaScript, Python, or C#), with a proven track record of delivering clean, maintainable, and scalable code within complex systems.
  • Deployment and Version Control: Deep hands-on experience with deployment tooling across Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes environments, along with expert-level use of version control systems (e.g., Git, SVN) in enterprise development workflows.
  • Cloud Computing Expertise: Demonstrated expertise in deploying and scaling applications across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a strategic understanding of cloud-native architecture and DevOps best practices.
  • Generative AI Ecosystem Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of the generative AI ecosystem, including frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack) and familiarity with cloud-native AI platforms (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure ML), enabling you to architect end-to-end AI solutions.
  • Data & Analytics Fluency: Strong background in data engineering, analytics, or data science, with the ability to design data pipelines and workflows across structured and unstructured data. Hands-on experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Hive) and database systems (SQL and NoSQL)
  • Graph Database Authority: Deep expertise in graph data modeling and query languages (e.g., Cypher), along with practical experience working with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph) or triple stores (e.g., Ontotext, Stardog), enabling advanced knowledge graph applications
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills: Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and align technical decisions with business goals.
  • Problem-Solving and Analytical Abilities: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to break down complex problems, architect AI solutions, and mentor teams through implementation
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to engage with customers, lead strategic discussions and ensure successful project execution.

The annual on target earnings range for this position based in the United States is listed below. This range is an estimate, and the actual on target earnings may vary based on Neo4j’s compensation practices, job related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and trainings, in addition to geographic location. Based on the factors above, Neo4j utilizes the full width of the range.

In addition to the range below, US employees are eligible for a stock option grant and certain roles are eligible for an annual bonus. Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s standard benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k), paid time off, and certain leaves of absence.

Annual On Target Earnings Range
$200,000—$265,000 USD

Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

raw.description:
This role is fully remote and would require about 50% of travel, including weekends.

About Total Health: Total Health is a medical education company dedicated to creating high-quality educational programs and experiences for oncology healthcare professionals. We develop and execute live, virtual, and hybrid conferences that bring together leading experts, healthcare providers, industry partners, and the patient perspective.

Our team combines thoughtful program development with exceptional execution to deliver education that is relevant, engaging, inclusive, and impactful for the oncology community.

Summary: The Program Coordinator plays a key role in the planning, promotion, and execution of multiple medical education programs throughout the year. Coordinators take ownership of their assigned programs from initial planning and attendee recruitment through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation.

This position requires someone who can confidently manage competing priorities, communicate professionally with a wide range of stakeholders, anticipate needs, and take ownership of details and deadlines. Successful candidates will be comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with a remote, cross-functional team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both behind-the-scenes planning and being on-site to bring an event to life. Frequent travel is an essential part of the position, including weekend travel and event execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the planning and execution of multiple live, virtual, and hybrid oncology education programs from initial planning through completion.
  • Develop and maintain program timelines, task lists, budgets, and key deliverables to ensure programs remain on schedule and within budget.
  • Take an active role in attendee recruitment for assigned programs, developing and executing targeted outreach strategies to drive registration and achieve attendance goals.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for program faculty, vendors, venues, partners, and other stakeholders throughout the planning process.
  • Coordinate faculty logistics, including invitations, scheduling, travel, accommodations, meeting materials, and on-site needs.
  • Manage event logistics including venue coordination, food and beverage, audiovisual requirements, room setups, signage, shipping, registration, and other operational details.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, including Sales, Marketing, Accreditation, and Finance, to ensure program deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
  • Track program expenses, invoices, and budget activity while identifying potential discrepancies and opportunities for cost efficiencies.
  • Schedule and facilitate planning calls, internal check-ins, and post-program debriefs, ensuring action items are documented and completed.
  • Provide hands-on, on-site event management, including registration, faculty and sponsor support, vendor coordination, room management, and troubleshooting.
  • Anticipate potential challenges and proactively identify solutions before they impact the program, faculty, partners, or attendees.
  • Maintain organized and accurate program records, documentation, and internal tracking systems.
  • Support adherence to applicable medical education, accreditation, and industry compliance requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, program execution, and the overall attendee experience.
  • Support additional programs, initiatives, and special projects as needed.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree preferred

Professional Skills and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in meeting planning, conference management, event operations, medical education, hospitality, or a related field; healthcare or medical education experience is preferred.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple programs, deadlines, and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate professionally with physicians, partners, vendors, clients, and colleagues.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate unexpected changes calmly and effectively.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with event management, project management, registration, or CRM platforms is a plus.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer-service skills.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a remote, cross-functional team.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently drive assigned programs toward established attendance, budget, timeline, and execution goals.
  • A growth-oriented mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, collaboration, and shared team success.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including frequent weekend travel and occasional early-morning or evening event responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Successful Program Coordinators at Total Health are highly organized, accountable, and proactive. They take ownership of their programs, communicate early and often, stay several steps ahead of deadlines, and understand that a successful meeting is measured by more than flawless logistics.
  • They actively work toward program goals, including attendee recruitment and registration, while ensuring faculty, partners, vendors, and attendees receive a high-quality experience.
  • Our Program Coordinators are equally comfortable developing a program timeline from their home office, communicating with a nationally recognized physician, conducting targeted outreach to prospective attendees, reviewing a hotel banquet order, managing an on-site registration desk, and quickly solving an unexpected challenge during a live event.

Why Join Total Health?

At Total Health, our work is centered on creating meaningful educational experiences that can ultimately contribute to better oncology care. Our programs and company culture are guided by a commitment to:

  • Evidence-based, unbiased medical education
  • Meaningful representation of diverse voices in science and medicine
  • Detail-driven, thoughtful program execution
  • Health equity and addressing disparities in cancer care
  • Geographic, cultural, and professional diversity
  • Gender equity in faculty and leadership opportunities
  • Incorporating the often-unheard patient perspective

Join Us in Making a Difference

If you are energized by fast-moving work, enjoy taking ownership of complex projects, and want to help create exceptional educational experiences for the oncology community, we would love to hear from you.
